items.jobTitle: Product Owner – Software Architecture Integration Testing
items.jobDescription:
About JLR:
 Innovative. Trusted. Pioneering. These three qualities have always summed up Jaguar Land Rover. They have been encapsulated within the performance, luxury and excellence of all our products. They are what every person working for us lives and breathes. From creating intelligent hybrids to building driverless vehicles, evolving existing technologies to discovering new energy storage, our ambition for the future of our vehicles and the industry beyond is endless. 
 Brief Description about the role: The Electrification Core engineering team requires experienced power electronics system engineers to apply best in class design & analysis skills and derive system specifications, requirements for delivering Jaguar Land Rover's in-house electronic design, charging system for PHEV & BEV. Objective is to deliver levels of reliability and robustness exceeding anything that we have seen before. 
 Skills, experience and qualifications: 
 Essential: 
 Bachelor, master’s degree in electrical/electronic/instrumentation/computer engineering
 Proven understanding of power electronics switching, Battery, charging modules hardware and software algorithms.
 Minimum 10 years of industry experience in Realtime Embedded software architecture validation for QM and High Integrity software 
 Extensive experience in AUTOSAR and Non-AUTOSAR compliant software development delivery through technical teams
 Extensive experience in planning and prioritization of software architecture integration tests and stakeholder management ( Product Owner )
 Experience in Software architecture validation environments (Ex: vECU/ VT system/Bench Rigs)
 Hands-on experience in software integration testing and maintaining the platform stability .
 Proficiency in requirements definition and requirements management tooling (TRM or similar)
 Experience of model-based systems engineering tools and techniques (ideally CATIA Magic Systems) 
 Understanding of systems engineering “V” life cycle, working experience with ASPICE process
 Experience in end-to-end software delivery
 Experience in version control tools like Tortoise SVN, Git 
 Experience in Rally/ JIRA or similar project management tools 
 Excellent communication and presentation skills. Experience of meeting deadlines.
 Strong people skills and the ability to work individually and in a cross functional team
 Required tools knowledge:
 MBSE tool such as CATIA Magic Systems or similar (MSOSA)
 SystemDesk/EB Tresos
 JIRA/Confluence/GIT 
 Visual Studio
 Embedded C
 CANalyzer and CANoe
 Trace32 / Lauterbach (debugging)
 MATLAB/Simulink 
 X RAY
 Desired:
 Extensive hands-on experience in development of AUTOSAR architecture for QM and High Integrity using System Desk/EB Tresos/Architecture development Tools
 End-to-end knowledge of AUTOSAR and non-AUTOSAR architectures .
 Product design lifecycle experience/Automotive Embedded software life cycle 
 A knowledge of typical BEV, MHEV and PHEV SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) solutions and technologies 
 Key responsibilities of the role will include:
 Define and maintain the SWE5 Integration strategy and scope of testing.
 Own the Software Architecture Validation backlog and roadmap for High-Integrity ECU platforms. 
 Responsible for software architecture Platform stability. 
 Define, plan, and prioritize software architecture integration and validation activities in alignment with program milestones. 
 Creating the epics and user stories for integration testing activities and estimate the efforts.
 Collaborate with Software Architects, Systems Engineers, Product Managers, and Feature Owners to ensure architecture readiness. 
 Drive validation of AUTOSAR and Non-AUTOSAR software architectures across virtual and physical validation environments. 
 Lead architecture integration testing in vECU, SiL, HiL, VT systems, bench rigs , and vehicle platforms. 
 Ensure platform stability, software quality ( ASPICE & ISO26262 ), and integration readiness throughout the development lifecycle. 
 Manage architecture-related requirements and traceability using requirements management tools. 
 Support end-to-end software delivery following the Systems Engineering V-Cycle and ASPICE processes. 
 Prioritize architecture enablers, technical debt, defect resolution, and platform enhancements based on business and technical value. 
 Coordinate cross-functional stakeholders across Systems, Hardware, Functional Safety, Cybersecurity, and Software teams. 
 Drive issue resolution and risk management for architecture integration and validation activities. 
 Support software release planning and architecture sign-off activities.

Application Software Design Engineer — Power Electronics (E-Band)
 Band
 E-Band — Engineer
 Experience
 1 to 5 years
 Function
 R&D — Power Electronics / Embedded Systems
 Domain
 DC-DC converters, chargers, inverters, motor controllers (EV / industrial power conversion)
 Location
 Bengaluru
 Role Summary
 Designs and implements the application-layer software that sits above the low-level drivers and control loops on power converter platforms — state machines, sequencing logic, diagnostics, calibration/parameter management, and host/HMI communication. Works closely with the firmware and control teams to integrate application logic with the underlying RTOS, CAN/RS-485 stacks, and (where applicable) AUTOSAR software components, under guidance from senior engineers.
 Key Responsibilities
 Design and implement application-layer software on STM32, C2000-based converter platforms — system state machines (init/standby/run/fault), sequencing, and mode management
 Translate functional/system requirements into application software design — flowcharts, state diagrams, interface specs
 Implement fault detection, protection sequencing, and diagnostic logic that consumes outputs from the control-loop (PI/PID) and driver layers
 Develop and maintain calibration/parameter management (configurable thresholds, lookup tables, EEPROM/flash-backed settings)
 Implement application-side CAN (J1939/proprietary) and RS-485 (Modbus) message handling — signal packing/unpacking, timeouts, fault frames
 Integrate application logic with the existing RTOS task structure (FreeRTOS) — task/queue/event design at the application layer
 Where the platform uses AUTOSAR, implement and configure Application SWCs / RTE interfaces under senior guidance
 Support UDS/diagnostic service implementation (DTC handling, session control) where applicable
 Debug end-to-end system behavior using CAN analyzer, logic analyzer, and on-target debugging (JTAG/SWD)
 Write unit/integration tests for application logic; participate in code reviews and MISRA-C cleanup
 Support bench validation, HIL testing, and bring-up of new converter variants
 Must-Have Skills
 Experience: 2–5 years in embedded application/system software, ideally power electronics or motor-control adjacent
 MCU platform: Solid hands-on with STM32, C2000; comfortable reading/working with STM32, C2000 code at the application/interface level
 RTOS: Working knowledge of FreeRTOS or similar — tasks, queues, semaphores, event groups
 Control-loop interfacing: Working understanding of PI/PID control outputs and how application logic sequences around them (not tuning ownership)
 Protocols: Hands-on with CAN and RS-485/Modbus at the application/message-handling level
 AUTOSAR: Familiarity with Application SWC / RTE concepts — coursework or project-level exposure is acceptable
 State machines: Demonstrated experience designing and implementing state-machine-driven embedded application logic
 Tools: Comfortable with CAN analyzer (PCAN/Vector), oscilloscope for cross-checking system behavior, JTAG/SWD debugging
 Fundamentals: Strong C, structured design practices, and clear requirement-to-code traceability
 Good-to-Have
 Exposure to UDS/diagnostics (ISO 14229) and DTC management
 Scripting (Python) for test automation, log parsing, or calibration tooling
 Git, static analysis tools (Coverity/PC-lint), Jenkins/CI exposure
 Exposure to Simulink/Embedded Coder or model-based application design
 Prior work on chargers, inverters, or motor controllers in an EV/industrial setting
 Qualification
 B.E./B.Tech — Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, Instrumentation, or related discipline

invenio ist ein Engineering- und Technologieunternehmen und entwickelt mit ca. 500 Mitarbeitenden an 10 nationalen Standorten Produkt- und Software-Lösungen für die Automobilbranche, Medizintechnik, Haushaltsgeräteindustrie und den Maschinenbau.
 Aufgaben:
 Mitarbeit in Projektteams bei der Entwicklung und Kalibrierung von Steuerungs- und Regelungsfunktionen für zukünftige Fahrzeuggenerationen, die weltweit eingesetzt werden
 Bearbeitung der Schwerpunkte Performance, Abgasnachbehandlung, OBD-Systeme und Fahrbarkeit im Rahmen der Entwicklungs- und Kalibrierungsarbeiten
 Planung und Durchführung von Tests mit moderner Messtechnik an Prüfständen und Fahrzeugen sowie in Simulationen
 Teilnahme an Versuchsfahrten im In- und Ausland zur Erprobung und Bewertung der entwickelten Funktionen
 Auswertung und Dokumentation der Testergebnisse sowie Präsentation der gewonnenen Erkenntnisse und Ergebnisse im Team
 Know-how:
 Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Mechatronik, Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
 Praxiserfahrung in der Applikation von Verbrennungsmotoren sowie in der Regelungstechnik und mit den geltenden europäischen Abgasvorschriften
 Erfahrung im Umgang mit Applikations- und Auswertungssoftware, insbesondere mit INCA, Uniplot, Concerto und Matlab/Simulink
 Bereitschaft zu weltweiten Einsätzen und den damit verbundenen Reisen
 Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Durchsetzungsvermögen und eine starke Orientierung an der Zusammenarbeit im Team
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse
 Benefits bei invenio:
 Spannende Projekte und herausfordernde Aufgaben, bei denen Sie früh Verantwortung übernehmen dürfen
 Eine Unternehmenskultur, in der Ihre Meinung gefragt ist und Sie mit Ihren Ideen etwas bewegen können
 Karrieremöglichkeiten für alle Altersklassen und Karrierestufen
 Eine kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre mit offenen und verständnisvollen Kollegen und Führungskräften
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, die genügend Freiraum für Ihre persönliche Weiterentwicklung und Ihr Privatleben lassen

Career Area
 Engineering
 Job Description
 Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 
 When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.

We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. We don't just talk about progress and innovation here – we make it happen, with our customers, where we work and live. Together, we are building a better world, so we can all enjoy living in it.
Die Caterpillar Energy Solutions GmbH steht mit ihren beiden Marken MWM und CAT für hocheffiziente und umweltfreundliche Anlagen zur dezentralen Energieerzeugung. Das in Mannheim ansässige Unternehmen wurde im Jahre 1871 vom Autopionier Carl Benz gegründet. Die Produkte stehen für mehr als 150 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Optimierung von Gasmotoren und Stromaggregaten für Erdgas, Biogas und weitere Sondergase. Seit November 2011 ist unser Unternehmen Teil des Caterpillar-Konzerns.
Für unseren Bereich „ Engine Performance and Controls “ suchen wir zwei
 Applikationsingenieurs (m/w/d)
 Einsatzort: Mannheim
Im Bereich Engine Performance & Controls gestalten wir die nächste Generation leistungsfähiger und effizienter Großmotoren. Dabei entwickeln und validieren wir innovative Lösungen für Brennverfahren, Motorsteuerung, Turbolader- und Luftsysteme sowie das Thermomanagement des Gesamtaggregats. Durch die intelligente Verknüpfung von Systemverständnis, experimenteller Erprobung und Datenanalyse schaffen wir Technologien, die Maßstäbe bei Performance, Effizienz, Emissionen und Zuverlässigkeit setzen.
Als erfahrener Applikationsingenieur (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle in der Entwicklung neuer Technologien und Produkte. Sie analysieren komplexe Systemzusammenhänge, gestalten Steuerungs- und Regelungsstrategien und treffen datenbasierte Entscheidungen, die direkten Einfluss auf unsere künftigen Produkte haben. Dabei arbeiten Sie in einem internationalen Netzwerk aus Entwicklungs-, Software-, System- und Testingenieuren zusammen.
 Das Sind Ihre Aufgaben Bei Uns Im Team
 Applikation, Optimierung und Validierung von Steuerungs- und Regelungsfunktionen für Motor- und Subsysteme
 Definition technischer Anforderungen sowie Planung, Validierung und Bewertung neuer Komponenten, Systeme und Technologien hinsichtlich Performance, Robustheit und Produktreife
 Inbetriebnahme und Applikation neuer Motor- und Systemkonfigurationen
 Entwicklung und Anwendung datengetriebener Analyseverfahren zur Bewertung von Systemverhalten und Ableitung technischer Empfehlungen
 Durchführung strukturierter Ursachenanalysen bei Entwicklungs-, Produktions- und Feldproblemen
 Technische Unterstützung des Vertriebs bei der Bewertung kundenspezifischer Anforderungen und der Entwicklung hierfür geeigneter Lösungen
 Das Sollten Sie Mitbringen
 Abgeschlossenes Studium in Maschinenbau, Mechatronik, Regelungstechnik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Applikation von Motorsteuerungen, Steuergerätesoftware oder ähnlichen Systemen.
 Fundierte Kenntnisse von Verbrennungsmotoren sowie Steuerungs-, Regelungs- und Subsystemfunktionen.
 Erfahrung in Entwicklungs- und Validierungsversuchen sowie im Umgang mit Messdaten und komplexen Datensätzen.
 Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten, strukturierte Problemlösungskompetenz und sicheres Projektmanagement.
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse (B2) und starke Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
 Wünschenswerte Qualifikationen
 Erfahrung mit Vector CANape oder vergleichbaren Applikationswerkzeugen.
 Kenntnisse in Python für Datenanalyse, Automatisierung und technische Auswertungen.
 Erfahrung mit MATLAB/Simulink und modellbasierten Entwicklungsansätzen.
 Kenntnisse moderner Datenanalyse- und Visualisierungsmethoden.
 Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit internationalen Entwicklungsorganisationen
 Zusatzinformation
 Diese Rolle ist vollständig vor Ort angesiedelt - fünf Tage pro Woche im Büro.
 Einstiegsgehalt liegt bei 82.805,48 EUR
 Ihre Benefits – Was Wir Ihnen Bieten
 Abwechslungsreiche und herausfordernde Aufgaben
 Hervorragende Verdienstmöglichkeiten nach Metall- und Elektrotarif Baden-Württemberg
 Tarifliche Sonderzahlungen wie Urlaubsgeld
 30 Tage Urlaub / Arbeitszeitkonto
 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
 Fahrrad-Leasing / Job-Ticket
 MWM 60 MW around the world Part 1 of 2
 Base Minimum Pay
 37.490,00 €
Please note that salary is only one component of the total compensation and benefit package available at Caterpillar.
 Posting Dates
 November 17, 2026 - Dezember 14, 2026

Wir sind Bertrandt.
 Ein eigenständiger und internationaler Engineering Dienstleister mit langjähriger Expertise. Mit branchenübergreifendem Know-how und einem ganzheitlichen System- und Produktverständnis schaffen wir technologische Lösungen entlang der gesamten Wertschöpfungskette. Wir beschäftigen uns mit den Trendthemen Digitalisierung, E-Mobilität und Autonome Systeme hauptsächlich für die Branchen Automotive, Luftfahrt, Defence und Maschinenbau und ermöglichen hier konsequent die Entstehung passgenauer Lösungen. Unser Ziel: den technologischen Fortschritt beschleunigen und einen relevanten Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Zukunft leisten. Daran arbeiten wir jeden Tag – mit rund 12.000 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern an über 50 Standorten weltweit.
 Ihre Aufgaben
 Als Testingenieur (m/w/d) übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Rolle bei der Absicherung und Validierung elektronischer Steuergeräte und mechatronischer Systeme unserer Landmaschinen. Dabei arbeiten Sie an der Schnittstelle zwischen Software, Elektronik, Mechanik und Hydraulik und tragen maßgeblich zur Qualität und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Produkte bei.
 Planung, Spezifikation, Entwicklung und Durchführung von Funktions-, Integrations- und Systemtests für elektronische Steuergeräte (ECUs).
 Erstellung, Automatisierung und Pflege von Testfällen und Testsequenzen unter Verwendung von ECU-TEST (tracetronic).
 Konfiguration, Inbetriebnahme und Weiterentwicklung von Hardware-in-the-Loop-Testsystemen (HiL) auf Basis der dSPACE-Toolchain (insbesondere ControlDesk und ConfigurationDesk).
 Entwicklung und Durchführung automatisierter Steuergeräte- und Kommunikationstests mit Vector CANoe und vTESTstudio.
 Absicherung komplexer Steuergerätefunktionen mit Schwerpunkt auf Antriebs-, Getriebe- und mechatronischen Systemen.
 Analyse von Steuergerätekommunikation, Systemverhalten und Fehlfunktionen sowie systematische Fehlerreproduktion und Ursachenanalyse.
 Bewertung, Dokumentation und Nachverfolgung von Testergebnissen und Abweichungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit der Software-, Hardware- und Funktionsentwicklung.
 Ableitung fundierter Aussagen zur Funktionsqualität, Testabdeckung und Freigabereife der getesteten Systeme.
 Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Testmethoden, Testautomatisierung und HiL-Testinfrastruktur.
 Ihr Profil
 Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Elektrotechnik, Mechatronik, Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.
 Fundierte Kenntnisse im Test und in der Validierung elektronischer Steuergeräte (ECU-Testing) sowie im Umgang mit vernetzten mechatronischen Systemen.
 Praktische Erfahrung mit ECU-TEST von tracetronic oder vergleichbaren Testautomatisierungsframeworks.
 Gute Kenntnisse der dSPACE-Toolchain (insbesondere ControlDesk und ConfigurationDesk) sowie Erfahrung mit HiL-Testumgebungen.
 Kenntnisse in der Anwendung von Vector CANoe und vTESTstudio zur Analyse, Simulation und Automatisierung von Steuergerätetests.
 Ausgeprägtes technisches Verständnis für mechanische, hydraulische und mechatronische Systeme, idealerweise im Bereich Antriebstechnik und Getriebesteuerungen.
 Kenntnisse in der Kommunikation elektronischer Steuergeräte über CAN und weiteren Fahrzeugnetzwerken.
 Analytisches Denkvermögen, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein.
 Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.
 Wünschenswerte Zusatzqualifikationen
 ISTQB-Zertifizierung (z. B. Certified Tester Foundation Level - CTFL), idealerweise mit Fokus auf Testautomatisierung.
 Erfahrung mit dSPACE SCALEXIO und der Entwicklung bzw. Integration von HiL-Prüfständen.
 Programmierkenntnisse in Python und CAPL zur Entwicklung und Automatisierung von Testabläufen.
 Kenntnisse in MATLAB/Simulink und modellbasierten Entwicklungs- und Testmethoden.
 Erfahrung mit Continuous Integration / Continuous Testing (CI/CT) und automatisiertem Testreporting.
 Erfahrung mit Requirements Engineering, Testmanagement und Traceability (z. B. mit Azure DevOps).
 Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung oder Validierung von Landmaschinen, Nutzfahrzeugen, mobilen Arbeitsmaschinen oder Automotive-Systemen.

Support Engineer Truck — EV Re-Engineering 
 Mission 
 Re-engineer and validate electric trucks, including vehicle networks, ECUs, electric powertrain, battery and BMS, using VECTOR and ETAS tools.
 Responsibilities 
 Analyze and optimize the E/E architecture and car network.
 Perform measurement, logging and diagnostics on CAN/CAN FD, LIN, FlexRay, Automotive Ethernet (DoIP), and UDS/ODX.
 Integrate and configure powertrain and BMS ECUs; flash software and manage software releases.
 Conduct vehicle-level and rest-bus testing, fault injection, root cause analysis (RCA), and technical reporting.
 Requirements 
 Degree in Engineering (Electronics, Mechatronics, or Automotive) or equivalent experience.
 VECTOR tools: CANoe/CANalyzer, vFlash, vTestStudio.
 ETAS tools: INCA, MDA; basic HIL knowledge (e.g., LABCAR).
 EV expertise: inverter/drive, DC/DC converter, OBC, HV battery pack, and BMS (SOx, balancing, HV safety).
 Ability to read schematics and wiring diagrams, rework harnesses, and troubleshoot on the vehicle.
 Requirements and bug management: Polarion/DOORS.
 Languages and availability 
 Professional proficiency in English and German; Italian is a plus.
 Willingness to work on the vehicle.

Job Tittle : AGM – BESS & C&I Engineering
 Department: Engineering / R&D
 Experience: 15–20+ Years
 Location: Bangalore
 Reporting To: VP – Engineering / COO
 Employment Type: Full-Time
 Job Summary
 We are looking for an experienced engineering leader to head BESS (Battery Energy Storage Systems) and C&I (Commercial & Industrial) product engineering and development.
 The candidate will be responsible for technology development, product architecture, system integration, engineering design, product certification, supplier qualification, and manufacturing industrialization for Utility-Scale BESS and C&I Energy Storage solutions.
 Key Responsibilities
 Lead engineering and product development for Utility-Scale BESS and C&I Energy Storage systems.
 Develop product architecture, technology roadmaps, and standardized product platforms.
 Lead electrical, mechanical, thermal, structural, and control system engineering.
 Manage integration of Battery Management Systems (BMS), Energy Management Systems (EMS), PCS, HVAC, and Fire Suppression Systems.
 Review and approve engineering drawings, SLDs, GA drawings, BOMs, and technical specifications.
 Drive supplier technical evaluation, qualification, and component localization.
 Lead prototype development, DVT, PVT, FAT, and SAT activities.
 Ensure product certification and compliance with UL 9540, UL 9540A, IEC 62619, IEC 61439, NFPA 855, and applicable Indian standards.
 Drive New Product Introduction (NPI), Design for Manufacturing (DFM), and Design for Assembly (DFA).
 Lead Value Engineering (VAVE), cost optimization, product reliability, and quality improvement.
 Manage and develop multidisciplinary engineering teams.
 Coordinate with manufacturing, quality, procurement, supply chain, and project execution teams.
 Educational Qualification
 B.E./B.Tech in Electrical, Electronics, Electrical & Electronics, or Power Electronics Engineering.
 M.E./M.Tech preferred.
 Experience & Technical Skills
 15–20+ years of experience in BESS, Energy Storage, Power Electronics, Solar Inverters, or EV Infrastructure.
 Strong knowledge of BESS architecture, battery systems, PCS, BMS, EMS, HVAC, and fire safety systems.
 Experience in electrical and mechanical product design and system integration.
 Knowledge of product certification, international standards, and grid compliance.
 Experience in product development, NPI, supplier qualification, and manufacturing industrialization.

items.jobDescription:
Work environment
 You will join a department with Group-wide lead responsibility for the development of high-voltage charging functions across the Volkswagen Group. High-voltage charging today involves far more than the interaction between a vehicle and a charging station. The vehicle, battery, backend systems, mobile applications, electricity tariffs, and charging infrastructure form a complex, interconnected ecosystem. For customers, however, charging should be simple, transparent, and reliable. This is where your doctoral research comes in: You will develop an intelligent, vehicle-based voice assistant for high-voltage charging that translates technical complexity into clear explanations and actionable recommendations. Why did my charging session stop? Why is my vehicle not achieving the expected charging performance? What conditions need to be met for optimal charging? And how can charging schedules be intelligently aligned with favorable electricity prices? Based on the current vehicle and charging context, the voice assistant should be able to answer questions such as these, explain technical dependencies and potential root causes in an understandable way, and provide customers with targeted recommendations for resolving charging-related issues. Building on an existing concept, your doctoral research will investigate how information from different systems can be integrated, interpreted, and processed in a context-aware manner to enable intuitive, dialogue-based interaction with the customer. The objective is to develop a future-ready assistance concept for intelligent and explainable high-voltage charging.
 Possible tasks within this role
 Designing and further developing AI-based communication solutions for customer interaction related to charging issues and potential solutions for both BEVs and PHEVs
 Extending the functionality to determine charging costs at public charging stations, taking into account the interaction between Charge Point Operators (CPOs), Mobility Service Providers (MSPs), and the vehicle’s charging schedule
 Developing AI-based control and decision-making approaches for vehicle functions as part of your doctoral research
 Designing and evaluating the performance of AI-based methods, benchmarking them against competitive solutions and conventional algorithm-based approaches
 Implementing and validating the developed methods in prototypes using MATLAB, Python, or comparable development environments
 The final doctoral topic is defined together with the professor. The prerequisite for the cooperation is the confirmation of supervision as well as a confirmed delimitation of topics by the professor of a university or research institution entitled to confer a doctorate.
 Qualification Requirements
 Good to very good university degree qualifying for doctoral studies in electrical engineering, automotive engineering, information technology, or a comparable field
 Experience working with system architecture models and requirements decomposition
 Knowledge of ISO 15118 and ISO 26262, as well as the modeling languages SysML and UML
 Experience in developing and working with neural networks, as well as proficiency in relevant programming languages, is desirable
 German language level B1
 Ability to understand and structure complex technical relationships, for example from use cases to software requirements
 Knowledge of pedagogical or didactic principles relevant to the development of language models and human-machine interaction is desirable
 The following documents must be submitted with the application
 Curriculum Vitae
 Current transcript of records / Master’s or Diplom degree certificate
 Keywords
 Dissertation, Charging, AI, KI, E-Mobility, LLM (Large Language Model), Volkswagen
 What We Offer
 Attractive salary & 30 vacation days (+ 24.12. and 31.12. off)
 35-hour week, flexible working hours, remote work
 Special conditions for the purchase and leasing of vehicles
 Free seminars on scientific work and interdisciplinary qualifications
 Participation in the doctoral network for scientific exchange with science representatives and other doctoral candidates within the Volkswagen Group
 The gross monthly salary for this position, based on a 35-hour workweek and scaled according to the respective year of employment, is €3,030 (1st year), €3,194 (2nd year), and €3,497 (3rd year). In addition, there is a monthly allowance of €167 as well as a 49% share of the variable bonus.

The role
 Evaluating modern combat systems and training tactical AI requires more than isolated component models or a fast software backbone — it requires architecting how operational reality is represented and connected inside a synthetic world. Beyond our core simulation platform, we are building the domain and kill-chain layer of our synthetic environment: specifically, how sensors, effectors, command and control (C2) nodes and communication networks interact as coherent, end-to-end kill chains across Red and Blue forces. To support everything from cloud-scale operational analysis (OA) and AI training to high-fidelity system verification and validation (V&V), our synthetic environment must be fundamentally modular — allowing us to scale scenarios and swap model fidelities without breaking the kill chain.
As a Simulation Engineer on our Simulation team, you will serve as the domain architect for this kill-chain layer. You will translate complex military operations into an abstracted, modular simulation architecture — defining the kill-chain interface control documents (ICDs), multi-fidelity model boundaries and domain integration patterns that allow heterogeneous models to plug into a single, scalable synthetic environment. Working closely with core software engineers, AI researchers and military domain specialists, you will ensure our synthetic worlds are architecturally clean, scalable across fidelity tiers and operationally credible.
 The day-to-day
 Architect the end-to-end kill-chain structure of our synthetic environment, defining how sensing, C2 and battle management, communications and datalinks, and effectors interact across Red and Blue forces
 Design and maintain the interface control documents (ICDs), data contracts and functional boundaries between kill-chain components so models remain strictly decoupled and interchangeable
 Design multi-fidelity kill-chain contracts that allow any sub-model to be swapped seamlessly across granularity tiers — from fast lookup tables and functional power-and-effect models to physics and signal-level representations — without altering surrounding kill-chain logic
 Translate real-world military doctrines, operational concepts and multi-domain engagements into clean, abstracted simulation architectures that scale from single-engagement V&V to large-scale constructive OA campaigns
 Deconstruct, modularise and integrate existing constructive simulation frameworks and partner domain models (e.g. legacy C++ sensor, effector and behaviour models) into our modular kill-chain architecture
 Collaborate with core simulation backbone engineers to ensure domain-level kill-chain designs map cleanly onto the underlying runtime, time-management and execution infrastructure
 Define V&V and consistency criteria across fidelity tiers, ensuring that lower-fidelity abstractions remain calibrated and credible against higher-fidelity reference models
 Connect military operational stakeholders, partner engineering teams and internal AI and platform teams to align all aspects of the synthetic environment domain architecture
 You should apply if you
 Have architected and delivered domain logic, functional interfaces and end-to-end kill chains (sensors, C2, communications, effectors) for military or aerospace simulation environments
 Design modular, multi-fidelity simulation architectures, abstracting real-world systems so that a lookup table, a functional model and a high-fidelity physics model can share a common architectural contract
 Apply deep military domain and OA understanding (Red and Blue doctrines, air and land combat systems, sensor-to-shooter workflows) to translate operational reality into formal system and interface designs
 Navigate, assess and modularise existing simulation frameworks and model codebases (e.g. C++, Python, MATLAB/Simulink) to extract domain logic and define clean integration boundaries alongside software teams
 Balance the architectural trade-offs between simulation fidelity, computational scalability and operational validity across different use cases (large-scale Monte Carlo OA, AI training, SIL/HIL V&V)
 Communicate complex architectural and operational concepts clearly across disciplines, aligning software engineers, domain modellers and defence stakeholders around shared interface standards
 Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.
 Nice to have
 Have architected or modularised established European or German constructive simulation frameworks (e.g. AFSIM or comparable national and international air and land engagement simulators)
 Have designed interfaces that allow classical rule-based or behaviour-tree doctrines to be swapped with AI- or agent-based decision models within a kill chain
 Apply distributed simulation standards, data models and cloud-scale simulation architectures (e.g. HLA/DIS, NATO MSG)
 Have built or supported large-scale simulation data-farming campaigns and analytical pipelines
 Have guided technical architecture or OA workstreams in multi-partner defence or NATO programmes

 LabView

About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 Overview 
Harmattan AI is developing new hardware products within the Launcher module: field-deployable drone launchers designed to be deployed and operated autonomously in demanding field environments. These products require dedicated electronics design with complex architecture in a constrained environment – PCBs integrating power conversion, energy management, control and communication interfaces – optimised for cost at volume. The Launcher team is seeking a dedicated hardware engineer to own electronics design end-to-end and accelerate the path to production milestones.
 Ideal candidate 
A senior hardware engineer who has designed and shipped complex PCBs, ideally mixing digital and significant power (hundreds of watts), into production. They are rigorous on schematics, layout, and bring-up, and have a strong instinct for cost and manufacturability. They design with real-world operating conditions in mind - temperature, moisture, surges - and an interest in battery thermal management; direct experience of outdoor-deployed equipment is a plus rather than a prerequisite. They are comfortable working autonomously in a small team and can bridge hardware and firmware.
 Skills required 
 PCB schematic and layout design (Altium Designer preferred)
 Power electronics design: ~300 W DC/DC conversion, protection, derating, efficiency and thermal budgets
 Thermal regulation: temperature sensing and control loops, battery storage temperature management, heatsinking
 Power over Ethernet (IEEE 802.3af/at/bt): combined power and data delivery, isolation, cable budgets
 Mixed-signal design: power management, MCU interfaces, communication buses (SPI, I2C, UART, USB, CAN, Ethernet)
 Hardware bring-up and debug: bench equipment proficiency
 DFM/DFA for PCB manufacturing and assembly
 Component selection and BOM management
 Experience in lightning and surge protection is a plus
 Responsibilities: 
 Schematic Design - Design complete schematics for mixed-signal and power boards, from power stages to digital and communication sections.
 PCB Layout & Routing - Perform or lead board placement and routing with attention to signal integrity, EMC, and power-path constraints.
 Power & Thermal Architecture - Define and validate the power architecture of the product and the thermal strategy, including battery temperature management.
 Environmental Robustness - Ensure the electronics withstand outdoor deployment conditions and define the associated qualification plan.
 Component Selection & BOM Optimization - Select components with cost, availability, and reliability in mind; drive BOM cost reduction for mass production volumes.
 Hardware Bring-up & Debug - Lead board bring-up, debug issues with oscilloscopes, power bench equipment, and other bench equipment; write bring-up scripts when needed.
 EMC & Safety Compliance - Address EMC challenges; ensure signal integrity across the board and electrical safety of the power and battery sections.
 Collaboration with Embedded SW - Work closely with the embedded software engineer to define hardware/software interfaces; support firmware bring-up.
 Collaboration with Mechanical - Ensure seamless PCB integration into mechanical enclosures (connectors, mounting, thermal, sealing, shielding).
 Supplier & Manufacturing Ramp-up - Qualify PCB manufacturers and assembly houses; support DFM/DFA review for production; manage NPI transitions.
 Documentation - Maintain schematics, layout files, test procedures, and hardware specifications.
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.jobTitle: Consulting Engineer - HVDC Controls & Protection Algorithms
items.location: Stafford, Berlin, Issy Les Moulineaux, Vereinigtes Königreich
items.jobDescription:
Job Description Summary 
The energy transition drives an unprecedented growth in demand for and generation of electricity. To accommodate this growth, the capacity of transmission system is projected to grow three-fold. High voltage direct current (HVDC) transmission systems will play a key role in connecting remote and offshore renewables, interconnecting energy markets and reinforcing AC grids. Converter stations are required to convert AC to DC and vice versa. The brain of such converter stations are the control and protection systems which, among other things, ensure efficient, safe, and reliable operation of the power electronic valves and peripheral equipment. GE Vernova’s Grid Systems Integration business line offers control and protection solutions for both voltage sourced converter (VSC) as well as line commutated converter (LCC) HVDC valve technologies to meet the transmission planning needs of utilities, system operators, developers and industrial clients worldwide. The control & protection algorithms are key to enabling the HVDC transmission systems’ functionality, capabilities and performance.
GE Vernova’s CTO office is tasked with developing the R&D roadmap for HVDC control & protection algorithms, managing competencies within the company, and supporting projects with specialised technical support. Consulting Engineers, who sit in the CTO team, are the highest technical authority within GE Vernova's Grid Systems Integration and Cross Electrification business. They act as executive technical consultant, ensuring customer confidence, reviewing and enhancing design practices, acting as a gate keeper for technical reviews, applying lessons learned, leading complex, state-of-the-art technology improvements, engaging with quality reviews and cost optimization exercises both within their specialist domain and across other domains.
GE Vernova is currently looking for an experienced technical specialist to join us as Consulting Engineer for HVDC control & protection algorithms. 
 Job Description 
 Essential Responsibilities
 Consulting Engineers are highly sought after within the GE Vernova business to provide expertise on challenging problems and to facilitate interfaces with adjacent technical domains. They are likely to have a number of publications, including conference papers, and patents. These professionals lead major technical initiatives, advocate for technological advancement, chair design reviews, mentor Principal Engineers and senior engineers, and benchmark their technology domain. They define the need for new design practices, author and review design standards, ensure lessons learned are documented and disseminated, and deliver effective technical presentations to upper management and external parties. 
 Consulting Engineers lead R&D and product enhancement projects with broad scope and significant impact on the business, acting as recognized experts in specific fields. They are tasked with major and complex assignments that bear long-term business implications, contributing to overall strategy and navigating complex issues within their area of expertise. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Serve as a recognized technical authority in HVDC control & protection algorithms solutions both internally and externally, and act as technical advisor to senior leadership levels 
 Actively contribute to and drive both internal and external standardization, coordinate working group activities and proactively represent GE Vernova in IEC/CIGRE and similar professional bodies, task forces and industry committees 
 Stay abreast of, collect and internally communicate state-of-the-art technology developments in HVDC control & protection platform algorithms and applications 
 Gather external information to determine future market needs 
 Work with external parties to identify new requirements, products and solutions 
 Collaborate with internal stakeholders to develop and maintain a strategic HVDC control & protection algorithms technology roadmap 
 Suggest areas for technological advancement and recommend approaches/programs to pursue 
 Evaluating and championing innovative ideas 
 Contribute to Intellectual Property management in terms of: The creation of patents 
 Participating in patent evaluation board 
 The review of patents to ensure freedom to operate 
 Mentor other engineers in the patenting process 
 Oversee various R&D programmes from conception through to industrialisation, integrating new technology smoothly into production and ensuring successful project delivery 
 Chair and act as technical authority in technology and product development gate reviews 
 Collaborate and promote technology synergies across GE Vernova businesses of Power Conversion Systems, Grid Automation and Power Technology, utilizing shared expertise and resources. 
 Support the commercial teams with their technical business development and sales 
 Support supply chain and procurement departments with technical expertise 
 Lead/support study teams addressing identified project challenges in focused technical areas 
 Lead/support the development of technical proposals to collaborate on the development of new technologies, functions and applications sponsored by external funding bodies 
 Support project technical tendering and delivery in the introduction of new solutions 
 Support the quality teams on major quality issues and act as technical authority in root cause analysis processes 
 Act as technical authority in competence management Identify and recommend improvements in specific discipline knowledge or technical training needs. 
 Contribute to creating structured training plans and associated training material 
 Delivering training 
 Mentor others to deliver training 
 Act as technical authority in competence assessments of senior and principal engineers 
 Lead/support the creation and presentation of conference papers and act as a validator to ensure that papers prepared by others are relevant, correct and of a high standard 
 Act as a knowledge ambassador, providing technical education to external universities 
 Consult with and support the Chief Engineer’s Office in executing the office’s technical objectives to implement best practice technologies and methods. 
 Qualifications/Requirements:
 The position requires a deep technical understanding of the technologies and design techniques required to develop, manufacture and maintain, high availability, real time, flexible control systems. 
 The successful candidate will deeply understand the intricacies of communication and computing platform technologies and techniques, and how to translate this into an effective value proposition to GE Vernova’s customers. This requires a strong foundation in both research and development and project engineering, having demonstrated significant technical depth and recognition as a domain expert across large scale, high reliability, high performance real time control systems, and able to apply state-of-the-art technology to resolve complex technical challenges. 
 Masters degree or higher education equivalent in a topic related to the development of control solutions, ideally with an application focus to power electronic systems 
 Proven experience in an engineering capacity, additional R&D funding 
 Excellent overall technical understanding of VSC-HVDC with deep understanding of the topics identified below: Control algorithm principles and high-level control system functional definition 
 Control algorithm implementation 
 Control software architecture 
 Harmonic stability 
 Interaction studies 
 Multi-terminal system control 
 Grid forming control 
 Multi-vendor control interoperability 
 Control system performance verification & validation 
 Understanding of LCC-HVDC control principles is not necessary but considered an advantage 
 Familiarity with patent evaluation, application and management 
 Open to regular business travel 
 Desired Characteristics:
 Strong oral and written communication skills 
 Strong interpersonal and leadership skills 
 Leadership to pursue correct engineering process in adverse conditions 
 Able to interface and communicate effectively with all levels of the organization 
 Considered an industry expert and thought leader in the HVDC control & protection algorithms discipline 
 Additional Information 
 Relocation Assistance Provided: No

Das IMD-2 – Werkstoffsynthese und Herstellungsverfahren erforscht und entwickelt Materialien, Bauteile und Komponenten für aktuelle und zukünftige hocheffiziente Energiewandlungs- und Speichersysteme. Dabei spielen Hochleistungskeramiken eine Schlüsselrolle. Die Forschungsfelder des IMD-2 sind: Werkstoffe für Hochtemperaturanwendungen (Wärmedämm- und Schutzschichten für Wasserstoff-Gasturbinen, -Fusionsanlagen und die Solarthermie), Gastrennmembranen für Wasserstoff und Sauerstoff, Sorbenzien für die direkte Entfernung von CO2 aus der Luft sowie katalytische Membranreaktoren für energieeffiziente Prozesse, Festoxid-Brennstoffzellen (SOFC) sowie Elektrolysezellen (SOEC) für die Erzeugung von H2 und CO und Beschichtungen für Niedertemperaturelektrolyseure, Lithium- und Natrium-Festkörperbatterien mit hoher Sicherheit und Stabilität für stationäre und mobile Anwendungen. 
 Das Fachwissen der Forschenden, das von der Festkörperchemie und -synthese über die pulverbasierte und nasschemische Verarbeitung, das Sintern bis hin zu Dünnschicht- und thermischen Spritzverfahren reicht, ermöglicht eine schnelle Anpassung an die neuen wissenschaftlichen Herausforderungen. Die experimentellen Aktivitäten werden durch Multiskalenmodellierung (von DFT bis hin zur Fluiddynamik und Finite-Elemente-Analyse) ergänzt, was zu einem besseren Verständnis und einer besseren Vorhersage von Materialien und Prozessen führt.

 Auswahl der Komponenten und Geräte in Bezug auf Funktion, Preis, Zuverlässigkeit und Standardisierung
 Programmierung von Steuer- Regel- und Leitsystemen
 Überprüfung und Dokumentation von ortsveränderlichen elektrischen Geräten nach DGUV V3
 Inbetriebnahme und Test der Steuerungsfunktionen, Sicherheitsabschaltungen sowie der Mess- und Regelkreise
 Planung, Durchführung und Auswertung von Wärmebehandlungen (z. B. Entbindern, Sintern und Glühen)
 Bearbeitung von internen und externen Aufträgen in Abstimmung mit den Firmen und den verantwortlichen Wissenschaftler:innen
 Betrieb, Wartung und Reparatur von Öfen und Anlagen zur Wärmebehandlung von Proben an Luft, unter Schutzgas und im Vakuum
 Erstellung von Betriebsanweisungen und Gefährdungsbeurteilungen
 Das bringen Sie mit 
 Staatlich geprüfte:r Techniker:in (w/m/d) mit Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Schwerpunkt Automatisierungstechnik oder ähnliches

 Chemische und physikalische Kenntnisse

 Vertiefte Kenntnisse im Bereich der Regelungstechnik, speziell Programmierung und Konfigurierung von Reglern über die Eurotherm-Software i-Tools

Our goal is to have a solar system on every roof, a storage unit in every house, and an electric car in every garage.  Job Description
 As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the internal platform that powers Enpal's applications and services. You will set technical direction, raise the bar on engineering standards, and drive cross-team initiatives that make our platform more reliable, secure, and scalable. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership, senior platform engineers, and development teams, acting as a force multiplier through mentorship, architectural guidance, and hands-on contribution to the platform's hardest problems.
   This role is ideal for engineers who have deep, proven expertise in platform and cloud engineering and want to shape the technical strategy of a growing engineering organization, not just execute within it.
 At Enpal, you would be:
 Owning platform architecture. Define and evolve the architecture of our internal platform, making build-vs-buy and long-term design decisions that balance reliability, scalability, security, and cost.
 Driving infrastructure automation at scale. Lead the design of automation and self-service tooling that removes manual toil across deployment, provisioning, and operations for the whole engineering org, not just your own team.
 Setting technical standards. Establish best practices for Kubernetes operations, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and infrastructure as code, and ensure they are adopted consistently across teams.
 Elevating the developer experience. Treat the platform as a product for internal teams: drive usability, reliability, and documentation improvements that let engineers ship faster and safer, and define the metrics that prove it.
 Mentoring and growing engineers. Coach platform and junior engineers, review designs and code, and raise the overall technical level of the team through pairing, documentation, and feedback.
 Leading complex, cross-team initiatives. Take ownership of high-impact projects that span multiple teams, from scoping and design through rollout, with minimal oversight.
 Driving continuous improvement. Proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and technical debt, and lead the changes that materially improve stability, performance, and automation.
 Partnering across the organization. Work closely with developers, operations, security, and leadership to understand real needs and translate them into platform solutions and roadmap priorities.
 Qualifications
 We are looking for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and a track record of leading platform initiatives.
 8+ years of experience in platform, cloud, DevOps, or software engineering roles, including significant time operating production systems at scale.
 Proven, hands-on expertise with cloud environments and containerized applications (Azure, Kubernetes and more), including designing and operating production-grade clusters.
 Deep experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), CI/CD tooling, Helm and observability tooling, with the judgment to choose the right approach for a given problem.
 A demonstrated track record of leading technical initiatives end to end, from design through rollout, across multiple teams.
 Experience mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar of a team, including through code/design review and documentation.
 Strong system design skills, with the ability to reason about trade-offs in reliability, scalability, security, and cost.
 Clear communication skills in English, spoken and written, with the ability to influence stakeholders at multiple levels. Knowledge of German is a plus.
 Nice to Have 
 Experience setting up or scaling platform teams in a fast-growing organization.
 Deep understanding of monitoring, alerting, and incident response practices, including on-call ownership and postmortems.
 Contributions to open-source platform or infrastructure tooling.
 Experience operating in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (e.g., energy, fintech).
 Are you interested even if you don't meet all the requirements? Apply anyway! We look forward to discovering your potential—regardless of whether your experience meets every single requirement. ☀️
 What we offer 
 Work at Germany's first green unicorn - Play an active role in shaping the solar energy transition.

 The ideal setup for your focus - We are convinced that excellent results are achieved when the conditions are right. That's why we rely on a hybrid working concept that gives you the freedom to always work in the way that best suits your tasks. Do you need new inspiration on an international level? With Workflex, we offer you the opportunity to relocate abroad for up to 30 days a year, depending on your responsibilities.
 Grown-up business & startup spirit - In our modern office in Berlin-Friedrichshain, you'll find everything your heart desires, from height-adjustable desks and table tennis to stocked beverage fridges and barista coffee.
 Your kick-start at Enpal - Onboarding day with a welcome bag, buddy program, and a team that really supports you.
 Stay up to date & help shape the future - Transparent all-hands meetings, short decision-making processes, and an open feedback culture - without mistakes, there is no progress.
 The energy transition can only be achieved together - At Enpal, you can expect legendary team spirit and unforgettable team events.
 Your extra boost - 29 vacation days + one additional day off on Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve, discounted membership at Wellhub, and corporate benefits. Everything you need to help you achieve a good work-life balance.
 Investing in your future – We don’t just think sustainably when it comes to energy, but also when it comes to you. Take advantage of our company pension scheme to build a solid foundation for your future, step by step.
 Make your home smart – Sustainability starts at your doorstep. As part of our team, you’ll benefit from a permanent 25% discount on the entire Bosch Smart Home product range – for an even more efficient and connected home.

Die Kompetenz der Deutschen Bahn ist weltweit gefragt. Als führendes Ingenieur- und Beratungsunternehmen im Bahnsektor bietet die DB Engineering & Consulting GmbH seit 1966 dieses Wissen – von der Idee bis zum Betrieb. Über 6.000 Mitarbeitende aus 96 Nationen beraten unsere Kund:innen in Deutschland und rund um den Globus, entwickeln technisch anspruchsvolle und maßgeschneiderte Infrastruktur-, Mobilitäts- sowie Verkehrslösungen.
Zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt suchen wir dich als (Junior) Bauüberwacher:in Bahn – Elektrotechnik (w/m/d) für die DB Engineering & Consulting GmbH am Standort Darmstadt, Frankfurt am Main, Fulda, Hanau oder Mainz.
du stehst kurz vor deinem Hochschulabschluss oder hast ihn bereits in der Tasche und suchst einen passenden Einstieg in die Berufswelt? Wir bieten dir einen abwechslungsreichen Job zwischen Büro und Baustelle – realisiere mit uns vor allem Projekte im Bereich Oberleitungsanlagen und elektrischen Energieanlagen (50 Hz).
Deine Aufgaben:
- Du gewährleistest die Realisierung von Bauprojekten und wirkst bei Bahninfrastrukturprojekten, wie den Generalsanierungen rechts und links des Rheins, zwischen Frankfurt und Mannheim sowie bei Großprojekten im Rhein-Main-Gebiet oder Richtung Fulda mit
- Dabei überwachst du die vertragskonforme Leistungserbringung der Baufirmen und bist für die Abstimmung zwischen internen sowie externen Baubeteiligten zuständig
- So oft wie möglich tauschst du Schreibtisch und Bürostuhl gegen Helm und Warnweste und verschaffst dir einen Überblick über den Baufortschritt sowie Anlagen- und Betriebssicherheit vor Ort auf der Baustelle
- Mit unserem digitalen Bautagebuch übernimmst du die Dokumentation und Berichterstattung, Abweichungen sowie Vorkommnisse und hast dabei stets Kosten, Termine und Qualität im Blick
- Während der Baumaßnahmen gewährleistest du einen sicheren und reibungslosen Bahnbetrieb (Bauen unter dem rollenden Rad)
- Du bist sowohl für die Freigaben der Bauabrechnungen und die Nachtragsprüfung verantwortlich als auch unterstützend für die Abnahmen der Bauleistungen
- Auch prüfst du Planungen auf die Umsetzbarkeit vor Ort an der Baustelle, wirkst bei Änderungen mit und dokumentierst am Ende des Projektes den Bestand
Dein Profil:
- Ein erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Fach- / Hochschulstudium im Bereich Ingenieurwesen der Fachrichtung Elektrotechnik, Kommunikationstechnik, Informationstechnik, Mechatronik oder ein vergleichbarer Studiengang mit Vertiefung in Elektrotechnik
- Idealerweise bringst du bereits Berufserfahrung, beispielsweise im Rahmen einer Werkstudententätigkeit oder in der Projektarbeit an elektrotechnischen Anlagen bei der Errichtung, Wartung und/oder Instandhaltung mit
- Du hast die Bereitschaft, dich für verantwortungsvolle Aufgaben weiterzubilden und dich innerhalb der Einarbeitungszeit zum:zur Bauüberwacher:in Bahn weiterzuqualifizieren, um dich für die bahnspezifischen Themen bereitzumachen
- IT-mäßig solltest du fit sein – die Bautagebücher werden bei uns digital erfasst
- Als Koordinationstalent runden Kommunikationsgeschick sowie eine zuverlässige Arbeitsweise dein Profil ab
- Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B, um im Rahmen deiner Tätigkeit einen Firmenwagen zu führen (auch zur Privatnutzung)
- Regelmäßig in Nacht-, Wochenend- und Feiertagsschichten zu arbeiten, gehört für dich dazu – du hast Freude an der Arbeit direkt vor Ort auf unseren Baustellen
- Für diese Stelle erwartet dich im Auswahlprozess eine Eignungsuntersuchung – auf unserer Karriereseite erfährst du alles über den Ablauf und die ideale Vorbereitung
Das ist uns wichtig:
Unser Anspruch ist es, allen Kandidat:innen bei gleicher Eignung die gleichen Chancen für den Einstieg bei uns zu bieten. Wir fördern aktiv die Vielfalt und das Miteinander in unseren Teams. Wir schätzen jede Bewerbung, unabhängig von Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter, Dauer der Arbeitslosigkeit sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität.
Deine Vorteile
* Faszinierende Projekte und Aufgaben – von spannenden regionalen Infrastrukturmaßnahmen bis hin zu den größten Baustellen Europas – fordern dein Können und warten auf deine Handschrift.
* Gezielte und individuelle Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten auf Fach-, Projekt- oder Führungsebene geben dir eine langfristige Perspektive.
* Bei uns können alle DB Mitarbeitenden günstig shoppen. Jeden Monat findest du auf dem DB Reisemarkt neue Angebote, wie z.B. Mobilfunkverträge, Versicherungen, Vergünstigungen bei Hotelketten, Mode und Lifestyle.
* Wir bieten dir 16 Freifahrten innerhalb Deutschlands pro Jahr und weitere Fahrvergünstigungen wie z.B. DB Job-Ticket für deinen täglichen Arbeitsweg. Darüber hinaus gibt es günstige Mitnahmemöglichkeiten für Familie und Freunde.
* Du leistest Großes und bekommst auch Großes zurück: ein marktgerechtes Gehaltspaket mit in der Regel unbefristetem Arbeitsvertrag und Arbeitsplatzgarantie sowie vielfältige Nebenleistungen und eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge.
Chancengleichheit und selbstbestimmte Teilhabe Schwerbehinderter und Gleichgestellter sowie eine respektvolle Zusammenarbeit sind innerhalb des DB Konzerns fest verankerte Grundsätze. Deshalb werden schwerbehinderte und gleichgestellte Bewerber:innen bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt berücksichtigt.

Mobileye’s Automotive Software development team is looking for SW developers to work on the cutting-edge of technologies bringing to market Mobileye Autosar self-driving platforms.
We are looking for experienced SW developers with strong debugging skills and Autosar diagnostic experience who are passionately motivated by challenges and excel in troubleshooting complex problems.
What will your job look like:
 Developing and configuring AUTOSAR modules, below the RTE.
 Creating and implementing software components on top of the RTE.
 Create design documents, SW requirements, SW unit tests and test cases.
 Establish bi-directional traceability between SW requirements and SW design.
 Optimization of the design or code in regards to consumption of resources.
 Debugging on bench and in vehicle, using Lauterbach debuggers, DLT and XCP.
 Participate in design and code and requirements reviews.
 Perform AUTOSAR embedded software integration.
 Troubleshooting and root cause analysis of issues.
 Participation in internal, customer, supplier and OEM meetings.
 Knowledge transfer from and into the development teams.
 All you need is:
 Bachelor’s Degree in Electrical Engineering or Software Engineering or equivalent technical field from an accredited institution, Masters is a strong advantage.
 4 years of experience on Embedded Software in automotive electrical & electronics industry
 AUTOSAR expertise, Adaptive AUTOSAR is an advantage.
 Strong customer orientation, willingness to meet deadlines, and self-management skills.
 Deep passion for solving problems to resolution, including root cause analysis skills.
 Ability to work and collaborate in a dynamic and global team environment and adapt to changing priorities and customer needs.
 Nice to have:
 Knowledge of scripting tools like Python, CAPL.
 Experience with software engineering tools (JIRA, GIT).
 Experience with UDS protocol / Bootloader / OEM Specific.
 Advanced experience with NXP processors and QNX OS.
 Advanced experience with AUTOSAR abstraction (Mcu, Wdg, Gpt, Dio, Port, Icu, …).
 Advanced experience with AUTOSAR BSW and RTE, architecture, specifications, and configuration tools (eg. ElektroBitTresOs, Vector DaVinci).
 Strong fundamentals programming in C, embedded system concepts, and software build process.
 Experience with software engineering process models (Automotive Spice (ISO 15504), Functional Safety (ISO 26262), Agile, MISRA C).
 Experience with Vector products (CANoe, CANape, vFlash, vT Family).
 Experience with debugging methods and tools (e.g., Lauterbach Trace32).
 Mobileye changes the way we drive, from preventing accidents to semi and fully autonomous vehicles. If you are an excellent, bright, hands-on person with a passion to make a difference come to lead the revolution!

- Erstellung und Weiterentwicklung funktionaler Architekturen durch die Zerlegung komplexer Systeme in logisch aufgebaute Teilsysteme und Funktionen.

- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Fahrzeugtechnik oder einer vergleichbaren technischen Fachrichtung.

- Kenntnisse in modellbasierten Entwicklungsmethoden und der Erstellung von System- und Funktionsmodellen nach etablierten Standards.
- Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Engineering- und Anforderungsmanagement-Tools sowie ein ausgeprägtes analytisches Denkvermögen.

What To Expect
 Join the mission to launch Cybercab, Tesla’s revolutionary fully autonomous Robotaxi, on the most advanced automotive manufacturing lines in the world. As a Cybercab Engineer, you won’t just support the lines… you will own them. You become a key individual partnering with cross-functional teams, to execute, and relentlessly optimize processes during the high-stakes ramping phase.
You’ll drive Tesla’s novel manufacturing method, the groundbreaking approach that breaks the vehicle into major modules built in parallel on open, highly accessible stations before final joining. This isn’t traditional automotive manufacturing. This is a radical, high-speed, modular manufacturing revolution, redesigned to shrink footprints, and unlocks blistering production rates.
These lines are loaded with cutting-edge automation and robotics. You’ll lead the deployment of advanced equipment process, focusing on quality/efficiency/safety targets, and execute an aggressive production ramp that few in the industry will ever experience. You’ll turn the most ambitious vehicle Tesla has ever built into reality at scale.
This is an opportunity to own world-class lines, master Unboxed manufacturing, and help write the next chapter of the automotive history.
 What You'll Do
 Program and debug structure text and ladder logic code on multiple PLC controller platforms (Siemens TIA Portal and Beckhoff TwinCAT)
 Create robust programs and sequences to control complex, multi-station machinery to perform processes such as material pick and place, dispense, fastening, welding, testing and material transport
 Use Python scripting and SQL to interface equipment with Tesla Manufacturing Execution System (MES) and to collect data into production databases
 Create intuitive operator touchscreen interfaces using Siemens WinCC

 Implement control reliable safety systems for safeguarding robots, gantries, conveyors, and other high-volume manufacturing equipment as per local codes and standards (DIN, VDE, ISO, IEC, etc.)
 Participate in initial equipment conceptual development and carefully balance product specifications, process requirements, layout complexity, cost, and lead-time limits
 Understand Tesla controls standards, work with suppliers during specification, design review, design approval, buyoff, installation
 Introduce automated processes into production, and train and equip the Maintenance Team to support automated equipment after deployment into production
 What You'll Bring
 Degree as Bachelor / Master / Dipl.-Ing. (TH / FH) specializing in Electrical, Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering, Computer Science or the equivalent in experience and evidence of exceptional ability
 Proficient use in Siemens and Beckhoff control systems
 Able to use common hand tools and diagnostic instruments such as multi-meters
 Industrial network and fieldbus topologies
 Very good written and spoken German and English skills
 Multi-tasking ability to manage multiple projects at the same time
 Able to work under pressure in the presence of stakeholders
 proof of in depth relevant professional experience in Controls Engineering
 Nice to Have
 Robot programming skills (Fanuc)
 Software programming skills (Python, etc.)
 Electrical design experience (EPLAN)
 HMI programming experience – WinCC, Ignition
 Understanding of databases and various program languages (Java, Python)
 Exposure to a wide variety of production machinery, industrial sensors, and equipment (DC nutrunners, leak testers, hi-pot testers, electrical testers

 Vos missions

items.jobDescription:
#### Your Tasks
We are searching for an experienced engineer with expertise in image processing and computer vision for space applications. The ideal candidate combines a strong background in algorithm development with hands-on experience deploying image processing solutions on resource-constrained embedded platforms such as FPGA- and SoC-based systems.  
The successful candidate is familiar with the complete processing chain, from sensor-level image conditioning and compression through object detection, tracking, perception and autonomous navigation, up to hardware-aware implementation for on-board space systems.
We are searching for an engineer who is experienced in one or more of the following areas:
- Low level image processing (image enhancement, filtering, calibration, compression, restoration)
- Computer vision and image understanding
- Object detection, classification and tracking
- Visual navigation, localization and perception
- AI-based image processing for edge and embedded systems
- Earth observation or spaceborne image processing
- FPGA and SoC implementation of image processing algorithms
**Your Responsibilities**
- Research, design and evaluate image processing and computer vision algorithms for on-board space applications
- Develop reference implementations for image processing pipelines in Python and/or C++
- Translate image processing algorithms into hardware-aware implementations suitable for deployment on FPGA and SoC architectures
- Develop bit-accurate reference models and support HW/SW co-design activities
- Optimize algorithms with respect to memory footprint, computational complexity, latency and power consumption
- Support implementation, verification and performance assessment of FPGA-based image processing solutions
- Evaluate and benchmark processing architectures and deployment concepts for future space missions
- Define system requirements, interfaces and verification concepts
- Coordinate technical activities with industrial and academic partners
- Support proposal preparation and customer-facing technical discussions
- Cooperate closely with embedded software and FPGA development teams
#### Your Qualifications
- University degree or PhD in Computer Vision, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Aerospace Engineering, Physics or a comparable discipline
- Strong background in image processing and computer vision
- Knowledge of low-level image processing techniques such as filtering, calibration and compression
- Experience with high-level image processing methods including object detection, tracking, scene understanding, perception or autonomous navigation
- Experience in developing algorithms for embedded platforms
- Understanding of FPGA- and/or SoC-based processing architectures (e.g. Xilinx Zynq, AMD Versal, Microchip PolarFire, NanoXplore)
- Experience with hardware-aware algorithm optimization and fixed-point arithmetic
- Familiarity with model-based design, bit-accurate implementations and HW/SW partitioning
- Programming experience in Python and C++
- Experience with VHDL, Verilog or HLS is considered an asset
- Previous experience in space, Earth observation, robotics, automotive ADAS or autonomous systems is highly desirable
- Fluent in English, both written and spoken

items.jobTitle: (Junior) Data Engineer | Knowledge Graphs & Pharma Data (f/m/d)
items.jobDescription:
Become a Part of Accurids
 Join us and help make medicinal product data useful for all! 
 At Accurids, we build the data backbone behind life-science innovation. Our platform identifies, links and standardizes critical enterprise data in line with global standards such as the ISO standard for the Identification of Medicinal Products (IDMP), and some of the world's largest pharma companies use it to bring products to patients faster and more safely. 
 You will join our Services department, a group of interdisciplinary experts who help our pharma customers adopt our platform and make it truly useful for their data. Within it, you are part of the data engineering team, which works in a clear, well-documented way: state-of-the-art tools, flexible processes, and agentic AI used in a structured, reliable way. You see your results in live customer projects within weeks, and learn the pharma data domain from people who have worked in it for years. 
 How you’ll make an impact:
 You transform data from a wide range of structured sources (such as CSV, JSON, RDF, and SQL and NoSQL databases) into the IDMP data model, and build the pipelines that keep it up to date.
 You use AI to turn unstructured sources such as documents and texts into structured, verifiable data.
 You bring a DevOps mindset to data: with AI as your everyday tool, used responsibly, you keep data flows and tooling tested, automated, documented and reliable, as the regulated pharma industry demands.
 You support the design of data models for IDMP knowledge graphs, leveraging the IDMP ontology, and learn to navigate graphs with SPARQL and agentic tooling.
 As part of a joint team with our customers, you work directly with their domain experts to understand their data and make their medicinal product data useful.
 What helps you succeed:
 A background in computer science, data science or a life-science subject such as biology, chemistry or pharmacy. A formal degree is welcome but not required.
 First hands-on experience in data engineering, data transformation or data preparation.
 You understand how software and data systems fit together and can read and judge code, whether you or an AI wrote it.
 Experience with version control (e.g. Git) and working in a team where changes are reviewed.
 You communicate clearly with your team and with customers.
 You live in Germany within commuting distance of Cologne and have a valid work permit.
 Business-fluent English. German is a plus.
 Coding experience in any language is a bonus. What matters to us is that you understand how programs work, not which language you learned it in.
 It's a plus if you have worked with RDF, SPARQL or knowledge graphs, have experience with AI-based information extraction, know the basics of data governance, or bring knowledge of the pharma domain and/or IDMP.
 Why you’ll love working here:
 Salary range of €50,000 to €80,000 gross per year, depending on experience
 Hybrid work from our office in the KölnTurm with a view over the city and free parking
 30 days of paid vacation
 Personal learning budget for trainings, conferences and certifications
 Your choice of a subsidized Urban Sports Club membership or a City Plus Card with €50 per month
 Hardware of your choice (Mac, Linux or Windows)
 A team of around 20 people with short decision paths, where your work is visible from day one
 A structured onboarding, together with other new colleagues starting at the same time
 Not ticking every box?
 Apply anyway! We care more about your potential, curiosity and motivation to learn than about a perfect checklist. 
 At Accurids we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We especially encourage women and people from underrepresented groups in tech, science and data to apply.

 Nordex adheres to a policy of equal employment opportunity. All employment decisions are made without regard to religion, age, sex, color, national origin, disability, or other protected class and are in full compliance with all federal and state laws.
