Who we are 
 Europe’s chemical industry faces an existential crisis resulting from a deep dependence on volatile fossil feedstocks, regulatory pressures, and cut-throat competition from China and the Middle East. Locally abundant bio-based feedstocks offer an escape route from fossil feedstock dependency, but chemical companies lack the technologies to bring them online.
 At Level Nine, we’re building an AI-driven catalyst discovery platform to produce key chemical building blocks from locally abundant bio-based feedstocks, reducing dependence on volatile global feedstock markets while using existing chemical manufacturing infrastructure.
 About the team & role 
 We are an interdisciplinary team of scientists and operators, supported by leading advisors, networks, and VCs across Europe. We’re based in Berlin, one of Europe’s leading deep-tech hubs. We are not looking for corporate specialists who need a finished process and mature documentation. We need high-agency analytical builders who are curious, reliable, and technically grounded, creating structure while the process is still evolving.
 As we transition towards executing our industrial demo plant, we are navigating developing a chemical process that requires robust process safety, structured discipline, precise control loops, and ATEX compliance. You will serve as our internal owner and technical challenger for process safety concepts, control philosophies, instrumentation specifications, and automation architectures.
 You will join our core engineering team to take on real, hands-on engineering work with direct impact. You will establish the control logic, P&IDs, instrument lists, and cause-and-effect interlocks for our design package, direct specialised skid-mounted engineering suppliers, build our campaign data backbone, upgrade our in-house pilot rigs, and ensure customer sampling campaigns achieve strict reproducibility. Your job is to challenge and translate our process design basis into safe, controlled, logged, and highly reproducible operation.
 Tasks 
 Control Philosophy, P&IDs & Instrumentation: 
 Draft, review, and release complete P&IDs, control topologies, cause-and-effect interlock matrices, and alarm philosophies across our process options
 Specify field instrumentation compatible with solvents, oxidants, and acidic media
 Establish PLC/DCS control system architecture, hardware requirements, and communication protocols for skid-mounted modules
 Process Safety, HAZOP & ATEX Compliance: 
 Be the internal owner for process safety, leading formal HAZOP, LOPA, and SIL assessment studies alongside external advisors and FEED suppliers
 Establish ATEX zoning classifications, specify explosion-proof electrical and instrument equipment, and prepare technical safety dossiers for local German regulatory approvals in coordination with host sites and TÜV
 Design safety instrumented systems and emergency shutdown logic for exothermic reactions, hydrogen peroxide dosing loops, and flammable vapour spaces
 FEED Supplier Interface & Site Co-Location Safety: 
 Co-author Level Nine's basic design package deliverables to set clear specifications for external partners
 Lead safety, instrumentation, and control interactions with specialised engineering suppliers through conceptual design, basic design, detailed engineering, and construction
 Oversee control cabinet assembly, shop testing, FAT, and SAT
 In-House R&D & Campaign Data/Control: 
 Design and maintain our campaign data infrastructure, including batch records, historian/DAQ structure, alarm/event logs, sample timestamps, control recipes, and partner campaign data packages. This backbone is what links laboratory/pilot experiments to reproducible results, FEED evidence, and GAP analysis
 Implement practical data acquisition and modelling tools for kinetic, thermal, mass/energy, and solvent recycle models, using appropriate tools such as Python, Excel, Aspen, gPROMS, ChemCAD, or similar
 Oversee control parameters during external partner campaigns, establishing standardised control protocols and logging systems to guarantee under 5% batch-to-batch variation
 Requirements 
 3–5+ years of hands-on working experience drafting and verifying P&IDs, specifying instrumentation, and designing control philosophies, cause-and-effect matrices, and safety interlocks for chemical process plants
 Demonstrated experience executing HAZOP/LOPA studies, ATEX zoning (Directives 2014/34/EU and 1999/92/EC), Seveso III compliance, and managing energetic or solvent reactions (peroxides, flammable solvents)
 Proven track record generating basic design control documentation and managing modular skid fabricators (such as Zeton) through detail design, FAT, and SAT
 Ability to collect data and model it using tools to draw FEED conclusions, establish dynamic models, and link experiments to reproducible results
 Professional German proficiency (C1+, strictly required to lead HAZOPs, liaise with German regulatory authorities like TÜV/Bezirksregierung, and negotiate with local EPCs and fabricators) and fluent English
 High agency, first-principles thinking, and practical engineering judgment. You treat safety not as a bureaucratic exercise of filling out forms, but as an opportunity to build safe, elegant, and workable systems in a fast-paced startup. You are comfortable getting your hands dirty troubleshooting sensors, control valves, or wiring on pilot rigs
 Pluses: 
 Experience building batch records, DAQ structures, or campaign data packages
 Degree in a relevant engineering field with a process safety specialisation
 Practical familiarity with Pressure Equipment Directive (PED 2014/68/EU) and SIL ratings (IEC 61508/61511)
 Though we have a number of hard criteria above, our hiring ethos is focussed on attitude over aptitude. This is far from a desk-only job, and we seek an out-of-the-box thinker who brings an entrepreneurial spirit and a can-do attitude. If you believe that process safety and control engineering can unlock strategic value beyond compliance and paperwork, this role is a one of a kind opportunity to define the next generation of industrial manufacturing.
 Ultimately we are looking for someone for this role who can match our ambition, resilience, and excellence. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion are what will stand out and set you apart. We strongly welcome diverse perspectives and people who have the courage and conviction to make real change. 
 How to Apply 
 To apply, please submit your CV along with 3–5 sentences about yourself and why you're interested in working at Level Nine. Please don't send us a standard cover letter - instead, please send a brief answer to the following questions:
 What is a complex process safety, HAZOP, or control loop challenge you have tackled on a plant or pilot rig, and how did you balance rigorous safety compliance with practical operational reality?
 What is something you geek out about outside of work that makes you uniquely you?
 If you could learn any new skill (professional or otherwise), what would it be and why? Please be specific.

 What Your Background Should Look Like

Dans le cadre du développement et de la validation des systèmes Powertrain pour véhicules électrifiés (PHEV et BEV), nous recherchons un(e) Ingénieur(e) calibration - systèmes Powertrain pour intervenir sur les fonctions liées aux états système et à la gestion des modes de conduite. La mission consiste à assurer la cohérence fonctionnelle entre les exigences système, les stratégies logicielles et le comportement véhicule, en garantissant la qualité des calibrations et la conformité des fonctionnalités Powertrain.
L’objectif principal de la mission consiste à assurer la calibration et la validation fonctionnelle des fonctions de systèmes Powertrain sur véhicules PHEV et BEV, en collaboration avec les équipes de conceptions..
 Vos Principales Missions Seront Les Suivantes
 Calibrer les fonctions IHM Powertrain : états levier, modes de conduite, état système, sens de marche et affichage de l’état de charge batterie (SOC).
 Analyser fonctionnellement les modèles Simulink et les spécifications logicielles afin de comprendre les stratégies de commande Powertrain et les interactions entre calculateurs.
 Interpréter les architectures fonctionnelles et les spécifications système pour vérifier la cohérence des exigences et du comportement logiciel.
 Élaborer et mettre à jour les PIV/IVP.
 Définir les scénarios d’essais, paramétrer, exécuter les tests et analyser les résultats.
 Réaliser les essais de validation fonctionnelle (Valfig) et rédiger les rapports d’analyse associés.
 Analyser les données d’essais pour vérifier la conformité des comportements système vis-à-vis des exigences fonctionnelles.
 Analyser les échanges CAN entre calculateurs (VSM / BSI, eVCU / CMM) afin de garantir la cohérence des informations échangées.
 Valider et suivre les ISS (issues/anomalies système) : identification des dysfonctionnements, analyse des causes et coordination avec les équipes logiciel et système.
 Réaliser la mise à jour du procédé de calibration du software pour la calibration du Powertrain sous CRETA.
 Participer aux échanges techniques avec les équipes projets et conception afin d’assurer le suivi des anomalies et l’avancement des validations.
 De formation Ingénieur ou Bac+5 en automobile, mécanique, électronique, automatique, énergétique ou domaine similaire, vous disposez idéalement d’une première expérience en calibration, mise au point moteur, contrôle-commande ou essais automobiles.
Vous maîtrisez ou avez des connaissances dans plusieurs des domaines suivants :
 Rapports d’essais et comptes rendus d’analyse fonctionnelle. 
 Mise à jour des PIV/IVP et suivi des campagnes de validation. 
 Analyse des traces CAN. 
 Reporting de validation et suivi des anomalies système.
 Outils : CANalyzer, CRETA, Simulink, INCA, MDA, Concerto, IDVH
 Protocoles & Communication : CAN
 Domaines : Powertrain, PHEV, BEV
 Méthodologies : Validation fonctionnelle, analyse système, calibration Powertrain

Your Mission: 
 As a Mechanical Systems Designer (all genders), you will join the Vehicle Systems team and contribute to the development and certification of the VÆRIDION Microliners’ mechanical systems. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the aircraft’s mechanical systems such as environmental control, ice protection, flight controls, landing gear, oxygen, and others, and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. You will translate system, interface and certification requirements into practical design solutions and take ownership of the associated 3D models, installation assemblies, and manufacturing drawings.
 You will work closely with the Propulsion, Systems, and Structures teams, as well as external development partners, to resolve integration challenges and deliver practical design solutions throughout the aircraft development cycle.
 The role will have a strong focus on hands-on CAD design, complemented by engineering analysis and certification activities. You will have the opportunity to define and mature the installation of multiple mechanical systems currently being developed. Every day will bring new challenges, and you will be given a healthy amount of responsibility and autonomy, always supported by the team.
   Your Day-to-Day: 
 Mature the mechanical systems installation from concept through detailed design and release, integrating it into the aircraft digital mock-up (DMU).
 Design and detail mechanical components, such as, brackets, supports, interfaces and assemblies in accordance with applicable aerospace design standards and manufacturing methods.
 Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform.
 Prepare and release detailed single part and assembly drawings, ensuring accuracy and compliance with industry standards. Oversee the documentation process to ensure all drawings are up-to-date and correctly integrated within the PLM system.
 Assess system, interface and certification requirements and translate them into robust and practical design solutions.
 Develop installation solutions that account for structural integrity, environmental conditions, separation, accessibility, installation sequence, removal envelopes, inspection and maintainability.
 Perform technical assessments and trade studies to support design decisions and system maturation.
 Collaborate directly with external development partners and suppliers, providing technical direction, reviewing deliverables and ensuring consistency with aircraft-level requirements.
 Support the resolution of installation, manufacturing and assembly issues arising during prototype assembly and aircraft integration
 Ensure adherence to all engineering processes and standards and participate in design reviews to meet development and certification goals.
   Your Profile: 
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Aerospace Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or a related technical field.
 At least 5 years of relevant professional experience, preferably in a design role on an EASA/FAA Part 23/25 aircraft development program.
 Experience working within an EASA Part 21J Design Organisation or international equivalent.
 Practical experience with the design and integration of aircraft mechanical systems. Experience with electric aviation is an asset.
 Strong proficiency in CAD software, preferably CATIA V5/V6, including experience in part design, generative shape design, sheet metal design, assembly design, and drafting.
 Sound knowledge of mechanical component design, aerospace materials, standard hardware and manufacturing methods, including geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, assembly and inspection requirements.
 Understanding of design-for-manufacture and design-for-assembly principles.
 Ability to develop and assess installation designs while balancing manufacturing and maintainability considerations.
 Experience collaborating with external development partners, engineering service providers or aerospace suppliers. 
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a methodical approach, attention to detail, and the ability to present clear rationale for solution proposals.
 A high degree of self-motivation, resilience, reliability and precision, combined with a strong sense of ownership.
 Collaborative team player with a positive attitude and the ability to work effectively in a multicultural team.
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; proficiency in another European language is an asset.
 Passionate about aviation and the electrification of the aviation industry.
 We recognize that women and other under-represented groups are often overlooked in our industry. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Talent and potential can’t always be captured in a checklist. 
   Why us? 
 Be part of an ambitious team determined to shape the future of aviation.
 We are an in-office company, but we value flexibility and trust employees to manage their schedules responsibly. This may include occasional remote work or adjusting hours to accommodate personal commitments.
 Subsidized EGYM Wellpass membership: your (mental) health is important for us.
 Enjoy a subsidized lunch with a 5€ company contribution per meal on office days.
 Become a part of our success with virtual stock options.
 Choose the option that suits your needs: either a free charging station for your electric car or a public transport job ticket as part of the Deutschlandticket.
 Lease a high-quality bicycle or e-bike through our JobRad program and benefit from tax advantages. Whether for your daily commute or personal use, enjoy more mobility and sustainability.
 Pension scheme to support your long-term financial security.
 Work in one of our offices in Munich or Delft. Enjoy the modern Balan Campus in Munich or work inside the aerospace ecosystem at TU Delft.
 Boost your professional as well as personal growth executing your own ideas and independent projects.
 Join our internal social events and retreats (e.g. cooking, game nights, sports).

We’re bringing together the brightest minds in aerospace, automotive engineering, and business to disrupt the aviation industry.

#### Your Tasks
**Internal Development of Mechanisms and Robotics Systems**
- Define and analyze technical requirements and develop concepts for space mechanisms, mechatronic systems and robotic applications.
- Support the complete development lifecycle from concept definition through verification and delivery, considering performance, manufacturability, reliability, cost and schedule constraints.
- Coordinate technical activities with multidisciplinary engineering teams, including Mechanical, Structural, Thermal, Electrical and Optical Engineering.
- Perform requirement flow-down, interface management and technical budget management at subsystem and equipment level.
- Take technical ownership of assigned mechanism or robotic equipment and support its development throughout the project lifecycle.
- Select, specify and size mechanism and drivetrain components such as motors, sensors, bearings, gear stages and transmission elements.
- Evaluate mechanical designs, engineering drawings, manufacturing concepts and tolerance allocations with respect to functionality, manufacturability and reliability.
- Perform technical analyses, trade-offs and simulations to support engineering decisions regarding performance, manufacturability, reliability, verification and cost, using tools such as MATLAB/Simulink and MSC ADAMS.
- Support Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) activities through active participation in integration and test campaigns, troubleshooting support and assessment of verification results.
- Support the development and evaluation of future robotic technologies and applications for space missions. 
 Contribute to technical proposals, internal R&D activities and the continuous improvement of departmental methods, processes and technologies.
**Technical Supply Management (TSM) of External Developments**
- Act as Technical Supply Manager (TSM) for externally developed mechanism, mechatronic and robotic subsystems. 
 Serve as a technical interface between suppliers, project teams and engineering disciplines throughout the project lifecycle.
- Define technical requirements, interfaces, technical budgets and acceptance criteria for subcontracted developments, support their proper flow-down to supplier level and contribute to the closure of related technical issues.
- Review and assess supplier-proposed concepts, analyses, designs, manufacturing documentation and verification evidence to ensure compliance with project requirements.
- Monitor technical progress, requirement compliance, risks, non-conformances and mitigation activities throughout the supplier development lifecycle.
- Support the preparation, execution and close-out of technical reviews and milestones, including SRR, PDR, CDR, QR and TRR activities.
- Coordinate and support verification, qualification, acceptance and integration activities, including participation in major subsystem test campaigns when required.
- Support the successful delivery of compliant, verified and fully documented subsystems in accordance with project requirements.
- Provide concise technical reporting and recommendations to project management and internal stakeholders.
#### Your Qualifications
- Successfully completed degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, Robotics, Mechatronics or a comparable technical discipline.
- 0-5 years of relevant professional experience in the development of mechanical, mechatronic, robotic or aerospace systems, including internships, research projects or student activities.
- Good understanding of mechanism, mechatronic and/or robotics engineering principles.
- Experience or strong interest in robotics, motion control, kinematics, autonomous systems or robotic mechanisms is highly desirable
- Strong understanding of mechanical design principles, manufacturing processes, engineering drawings, geometrical dimensioning and tolerancing, tolerance allocation and technical budget management, with the ability to evaluate designs regarding functionality, manufacturability, reliability and performance.
- Knowledge of mechanism and drivetrain components such as electric motors, sensors, encoders, bearings, gear stages, shafts and transmission systems, including their selection, sizing and performance assessment. 
 Knowledge of tribology, lubrication concepts and mechanical performance assessment is considered an asset.
- Understanding of systems engineering principles, including requirements management, interface management, verification and qualification.
- Experience with engineering analysis and simulation tools, preferably MATLAB/Simulink and/or MSC ADAMS.
- Interest in hands-on engineering activities, including hardware integration, testing, troubleshooting and participation in Assembly, Integration and Test (AIT) campaigns.
- Ability and willingness to take technical ownership of assigned equipment and subsystems throughout the development lifecycle, including the progressive assumption of Technical Supply Management responsibilities for external suppliers.
- Experience with CAD tools is beneficial for design assessment, communication with design teams and design reviews; however, the role is primarily focused on concept development, engineering analysis, technical coordination and system-level decision-making rather than detailed CAD design activities.
- Strong analytical, communication and teamwork skills, together with a structured and solution-oriented working style. 
 Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German language skills are considered an asset.

 Who We Are
 Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world.  Job Description
 HPE is a leading provider of networking hardware and systems, headquartered in Sunnyvale, CA.
HPE has an immediate need at its Bangalore location for a Senior level Power Design Engineer. This position reports to the Manager of Power Systems Development, a subgroup of HPE’s System Technologies department. The main objective of this group is to apply principles of Electrical Engineering and related disciplines in developing practical Power solutions to the very demanding requirements for the full range of HPE products, which includes both Front End and Board Mount Power technologies.
 What You'll Do
 The selected candidate will be an Individual Contributor within the Power Systems Development team. Assignments will be at the direction of the Power Systems Development Manager. Typical Board Mount Power activities will include definition of design requirements, selection of critical components, design/simulation/schematic capture of power circuit blocks and coordination with the Board Level and PCB Layout Engineers, and subsequent bring-up and characterization testing of the completed prototype design and introduction to Manufacturing. Similarly, the Front End Power System development process involves System Level Conceptualization, Power Supply Module Functional Specification, and the full cycle of engineering development with HPE Supplier(s), including prototype testing, system integration, documentation and Manufacturing support. Both Board Mount and Front End Power development responsibilities include preparing and/or reviewing test plans and supervising tests as well as in leading the Technical Peer Review of ones work as well as participating in that of other team members. As a Senior Level Individual Contributor, this position will also include Leadership activities such as Mentoring less experienced members of the Power Engineering Team, developing new Technology initiatives within the group, and participating in the HPE Patent application process.
 What You Need To Bring
 Qualified candidates should have a 10+ years related Power Design Engineering experience, with Bachelors in Electrical Engineering degree minimum, Masters of Electrical Engineering is preferred.
 Solid experience with schematic capture and simulation tools (including SPICE) is essential
 Candidate needs to have a practical background with multilayer PCB Layout tools and techniques.
 Familiarity with power development CAD tools such as Cadence Sigrity PowerDC is a plus
 Working knowledge of communication interfaces such as I2C/PMBus as well as firmware design experience are highly desirable.
 Role does require being on-site in Bangalore 2+ days a week, potentially more to meet business needs.
 Knowledge And Skills
 Using electrical design tools and software packages.
 Excellent analytical and problem solving skills.
 Experience in overall architecture of electronic hardware for products and solutions.
 Designing and integrating electronic components, integrated circuitry, and algorithms into overall architecture.
 Evaluating and proposing forms of empirical analysis, modeling and testing methodologies to validate component, circuit, and hardware designs and thermal/emissions management.
 Excellent written and verbal communication skills; mastery in English and local language.
 Ability to effectively communicate product architectures, design proposals and negotiate options at senior management levels.

items.jobTitle: Ingenieur/in (w/m/d) - Software-Entw. von sicheren IP-basierten Protokollen für Satellitenkomm. (Oberpfaffenhofen)
items.jobDescription:
Das Institut für Kommunikation und Navigation des DLR widmet sich der missionsorientierten Forschung in ausgewählten Bereichen der Kommunikation und Navigation. Seine Arbeiten reichen dabei von den theoretischen Grundlagen über die Demonstration neuer Verfahren und Systeme im realen Umfeld bis hin zum Technologietransfer in die Industrie und zum Wissensaustausch mit öffentlichen Bedarfsträgern. Sie sind eingebettet in die DLR-Programme Raumfahrt, Luftfahrt, Verkehr sowie Sicherheit.
 Das erwartet dich 
 Ein Arbeitsbereich der Abteilung Satellitennetze ist die Forschungsgruppe Integrierte Satellitensysteme, die sich mit dem Entwurf und der Entwicklung neuer Konzepte für satellitenbasierte sichere Kommunikationssysteme und deren Integration mit weiteren Systemen in einem anwendungsorientierten Ansatz beschäftigt. Als Ergänzung der Gruppe sollst du speziell Aufgaben zur selbstständigen und verantwortlichen Bearbeitung im Bereich der Entwicklung komplexer Protokolle und Algorithmen für die Satellitenkonstellationen mit spezifischem Schwerpunkt auf Protokollsicherheit für IETF-basierte Technologien (z.B. TCP, IP, QUIC, http usw.) übernehmen. Außerdem muss eine Schwachstellenanalyse der für die Boden-Raum- und Raum-Raum-Kommunikation verwendeten Protokolle ebenso durchgeführt werden, wie eine Analyse der möglichen Bedrohungen auf der Ebene der Satellitennutzlast im Hinblick auf die Instrumente an Bord, die Verarbeitungsfunktionen und die allgemeine Architektur des Raumfahrzeugs.
 Deine Aufgaben 
 Protokoll- und Software-Entwicklung für sichere IP-basierte Kommunikation in Satellitenkonstellationen
 fachliche Kontaktperson in den Bereichen neuartiger, effizienter Algorithmen, Protokolle und Software-Systeme für die Satellitenkommunikation, Systemmodellierung und Systemsimulation
 konzeptionelle Planung, Entwicklung und Durchführung neuer und schwieriger Forschungsaufgaben im Bereich komplexer Protokolle und Algorithmen für Satelliten Konstellationen
 durchführen von Performance-Simulationen sowie Validierung der erzielten Ergebnisse
 Anwendung der Forschungsergebnisse und Umsetzung in nationalen und internationalen Projekten
 analytische Betrachtung der erzielten Ergebnisse und Veröffentlichung in wissenschaftlichen Fachjournalen und auf Konferenzen
 Das bringst du mit 
 abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Master/Diplom Uni) der Ingenieurwissenschaften (z.B. Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik bzw. Nachrichtentechnik) oder andere für die Tätigkeit relevante Studiengänge
 praktische Forschungserfahrung (mindestens 2 - 3 Jahre) im Aufgabenbereich Entwurf und Implementierung von sicheren IP- Protokollen und entsprechende Validierung in Lab, z.B. erworben durch eine Promotion oder durch anderweitige nachgewiesene Forschungstätigkeiten
 umfassende Kenntnisse und langjährige Berufserfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Nachrichtentechnik, vor allem auf dem Gebiet der Kommunikationsnetze
 sehr gute Kenntnisse und langjährige Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Cybersicherheit, des Protokolldesigns und sicherer IP-basierter Protokolle für Satellitensysteme, d.h. IPsec, QUIC, TLS, SSL usw.
 sehr gute C++ Kenntnisse verbunden mit langjähriger Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Softwareengineering, Kommunikationsprotokollen und Netzwerksimulation / Systemsimulation
 sehr gute Englischkenntnisse
 Die Vergütung erfolgt je nach Qualifikation und Aufgabenübertragung bis Entgeltgruppe 14 TVöD.
 Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

The Software Developer I, Connector role supports Trial Interactive’s proprietary platform, Connector - the cloud-based integrations that move life science data between clients’ clinical systems (for example EDC/eCRF and IRT systems) and Trial Interactive’s life science products. Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the role helps build and maintain connectors, keeps client data flowing accurately, and resolves issues when it does not.
 This is a blended role, covering development and maintenance up until handling client requests. This role works closely with the Solutions, DevOps and Engineering teams.
 DESCRIPTION 
 As part of the Development and maintenance responsibility, the resource handles:
 • Develop, test and maintain connector components in C# on .NET (AWS Lambda), including the parsers and mappers that convert source-system data (API payloads, files) into the formats required by the Trial Interactive CTMS and eTMF.
 • Configure and extend mappings for new studies, sites and visit/status definitions on existing connectors, reusing existing modules wherever possible.
 • Assist in the technical onboarding of new clients and studies: connector configuration, test runs in non-production environments, and verification before go-live.
 • Work with the AWS services connectors are built on (Lambda, SQS, S3, EventBridge/Step Functions, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch) and make small, reviewed infrastructure changes using Terraform under supervision.
 • Consume, test and troubleshoot REST APIs (client/vendor APIs and Trial Interactive import APIs) using code and tools such as Postman, and help extend APIs that improve connector stability and connectivity.
 • Write unit and functional tests; use Git (feature branches, merge requests, environment branches) and follow the team’s code review and release process.
 • Keep code, configuration and change records documented so that others can maintain them.
 • Work on special projects, such as local test environments using LocalStack.
 As part of handling Client communication, support and ticket resolution, the resource does:
 • Own assigned support tickets from triage to closure: reproduce the issue, investigate, fix or escalate, and record the outcome in the ticketing system (for example Jira, ServiceDesk Plus).
 • Investigate data issues end to end – trace a record from the source payload through the archive, parser, connector database and logs to its CTMS/eTMF import result – and establish the root cause (RCA) with evidence.
 • Reconcile source-system data against the CTMS/eTMF when a client reports missing or mismatched subjects, visits or statuses, and explain any differences.
 • Communicate with clients and Solutions Engineers by email, tickets and calls: acknowledge requests promptly, ask clear clarifying questions, give regular status updates, and explain findings and next steps in plain language.
 • Monitor connector health (CloudWatch logs, failed imports, notifications) and respond to failures within agreed response times.
 • Escalate appropriately to senior engineers, DevOps or the vendor, with a concise summary of what happened, when, in which environment and for which records.
 • Write up RCAs, fixes and known issues so that repeat problems are resolved faster, and help keep support documentation current.
 • Handle client and clinical data with care: use the minimum data needed, never share one client’s information with another, and follow Trial Interactive data-protection and change-control procedures.
 General
 • Keep learning the connector platform, the clinical-trial data domain and cloud and software development best practices.
 • Complete all other tasks that are deemed appropriate for this role and assigned by the manager/supervisor.
 REQUIRED SKILLS 
 • Clear written and spoken English, with the ability to explain technical issues in plain language to non-technical clients and to write concise ticket updates and emails.
 • A client-service mindset: responsive, calm under pressure, and takes ownership of a ticket until it is resolved or properly handed over.
 • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills: forms a hypothesis, checks logs and data, and proves the root cause with evidence before concluding.
 • Strong attention to detail with data, such as identifiers, dates, time zones and character encodings.
 • Good time management: balances planned development work with interrupt-driven support, prioritizing by client impact.
 • Works collaboratively within a team, asks for help early, and is self-motivated and eager to learn.
 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE AND QUALIFICATIONS 
 • Bachelor’s degree or its equivalent in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
 • 0–1 years of experience in software development, technical support or cloud-based application support; internships and substantial academic or personal projects count.
 • Working knowledge of C# and the .NET framework: able to read and debug existing code and deliver small features.
 • Familiarity with AWS, particularly Lambda, S3, SQS and CloudWatch Logs.
 • Working SQL skills (joins, filtering, aggregation) on relational databases, preferably MySQL.
 • Understanding of REST APIs and of JSON, XML and CSV data; experience calling APIs with Postman or similar tools.
 • Understanding of data parsing and mapping techniques, including handling of dates, null values and encodings.
 • Experience or familiarity with version control systems (e.g., Git).
 DESIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE 
 • Experience with LocalStack for local AWS cloud application development.
 • Familiarity with Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code tools.
 • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and deployment automation.
 • Prior experience in customer-facing support, or with ticketing tools such as Jira or ServiceDesk Plus.
 • Exposure to clinical research systems and concepts (EDC, CTMS, eTMF; study, site, subject, visit) or to regulated (GxP) software environments.
 • Scripting (Python or shell) for data checks and log analysis.
 • Familiarity with containerization and microservices architecture.

Description 
 AI brings huge potential, but many companies are still struggling to release the desired impact. We are a pragmatic and dynamic team to help “empower our business clients with AI”. You, as a talent, are needed to grow our business which started up from three founders with proven track-records in AI consulting and scaled AI implementations. 
 For our powerful team, we are looking for a Swiss based AI Engineer / Consultant to develop and deliver innovative AI solutions for our customers in the German- and French-speaking regions of Switzerland.

 Design, implement, and deploy pragmatic AI solutions using state-of-the-art technologies, tailored to client needs and habits, to solve pressing business problems

 Work in high-performing, agile teams and play an active role throughout the project life cycle - from contributing to project proposals to designing and deploying solutions, as well as supporting business development activities
 Build strong relationships with stakeholders across clients, partners and internal teams
 Contribute to Artifact’s growth by developing assets and driving initiatives that support the company’s success
 What you can expect

 Enjoy a flexible work environment where you can grow, learn, and be part of a team that is passionate about AI
 About Artifact 
 Artifact is dedicated to empowering people with AI for the better. As a professional service provider, we do AI and Data Science. Together, we are leveraging the best ideas to find pragmatic and sophisticated solutions with the best suited technology. We help our business clients from any sectors and any size, to accelerate their journey with AI and deliver real impact. 
 Your profile 
 Experience in (Gen)AI and Data Science work with a deep understanding of Machine Learning concepts, including Deep Learning, Natural Language Processing and Computer Vision
 Fluency in Python, along with experience in Git, SQL, DevOps and MLOps
 Familiarity with analytics libraries, visualization tools and Big Data frameworks, e.g. NumPy, SciPy, Pandas, scikit-learn, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Spark
 First experience in designing and scaling (Gen)AI solutions in production on cloud platforms (e.g. Azure, AWS or GCP), with exposure to Docker, APIs, backend/frontend development, and microservices architectures
 Excellent written and oral communication (English and German or French is a must )
 Enjoying communication and building relationships with clients and teams is a plus
 Willingness to travel in Switzerland and available work permit in Switzerland
 You intend to start your new job  at Artifact within the next 3 months from your point of application
 Additional preferred qualification: 
 Experience in consulting
 Experience in frontend engineering e.g. React
 Experience as a full stack engineer is a plus
 You’re the ideal candidate if you’re: 
 Ready to move out of your comfort zone
 Willing to keep learning, and to stay up to date in the fast-moving field of AI
 Open-minded and eager to learn with people with different expertise

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!
 Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.
 We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.
 It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.
 🐙 Kraken Generation Flex
 The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.
 Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market-connected, controllable assets.
 🏠 Where you’ll fit in and role summary
 As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.
 You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market-participating asset.
 Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.
 🚀 What you'll own
 Integration design contribution: With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.
 Technical judgement: Develop your technical judgement, making well-reasoned decisions and trade-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.
 Developing domain knowledge: Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.
 Gateway application & configuration: Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.
 Hardware and Software Deployments: Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.
 Networking and cyber security: Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.
 Site testing & commissioning: Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.
 Incidents & compliance: Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.
 🧠 What you'll bring to the party
 Understanding of the Regulations: Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.
 Understanding of the UK Energy Markets: Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.
 Technical judgement: Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.
 Power plant systems: Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.
 Asset integration: Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid-scale and/or C&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.
 Integration design: Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.
 Hardware and Networking: Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.
 Industrial Communication Protocols: Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870-5-104, IEC 61400-25, OPC-UA or DNP3 is a plus.
 CAD, Diagrams and Tools: Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.
 Communication: A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.
 Commissioning landscape: Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.
 Engineering background: Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field - or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.
 A proactive and collaborative mindset: You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.
 Travel: Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.
 ⭐️ Bonus points
 Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.
 Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge-deployment architectures.
 Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git-based workflows.
 Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).
 Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

 We are HCLTech, one of the fastest-growing large tech companies in the world and home to 225,000+ people across 60 countries, supercharging progress through industry-leading capabilities centered around Digital, Engineering and Cloud. Our people are diverse, creative, and passionate, raising the bar for excellence every day. If this sounds like an environment where you’ll thrive, join us on our journey to advance the technological world through innovation and creativity.
 QA Engineer: GTM (Global Trade Management / GTS) 
 You will validate customs, compliance and trade-flow processes across our international footprint, including export/import declarations, preference and origin handling, sanctions and embargo screening, and legal control. Our products move across borders constantly, often under high-value and regulated conditions, so your tests must cover regulatory variations by country. You bring working knowledge of SAP GTS/GTM and its integration with SD/MM and logistics, plus the discipline to test the edge cases that cause customs delays.
 Common requirements 
 • Proven QA experience on SAP (ideally S/4HANA) in your functional area: test strategy, scripting, execution, defect management and sign-off
 • Ability to work with business stakeholders, functional consultants and developers, and to translate process into clear test evidence
 • Familiarity with test tooling and automation is a plus
 • Fluent English; additional European languages (French/German/Italian) welcome
 Engagement details
 • Location: Europe-based, aligned to CET working hours; primarily remote with occasional travel to Meyrin (Geneva)
 __________________
 We promote equal opportunities for all employees, regardless of their cultural and social background, gender, disability, age, religion, beliefs, and sexual identity. We give priority consideration to severely disabled applicants and those of equal status in the case of equal suitability.

About Us 
 Harmattan AI is a next-generation defense prime building autonomous and scalable defense systems. Following the close of a $200M Series B, valuing the company at $1.4 billion, we are expanding our teams and capabilities to deliver mission-critical systems to allied forces.
 Our work is guided by clear values: building technologies with real-world impact, pursuing excellence in everything we do, setting ambitious goals, and taking on the hardest technical challenges. We operate in a demanding environment where rigor, ownership, and execution are expected.
 About the Role 
 We are looking for a Supplier Quality Engineer to ensure that our suppliers are delivering at the right level of quality, in particular through audits and supplier development.
     Responsibilities 
 Conduct supplier qualification and approval (new sources, special processes).
 Conduct supplier / process audits (AS9100, special-process, APQP).
 Ensure FAI (AS9102) and PPAP review; receiving-inspection strategy and defect containment.
 Implement supplier 8D / corrective actions, scorecards, and be the owner of the supplier development; NDAA / AQAP flow-down.
 Collaboration and Communication
 Work with cross-functional teams, including R&D, Engineering, and Supply Chain, using platforms such as Jira or Confluence to document and track quality topics related to design projects.
 Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders, including customers and regulatory bodies, on project quality status and resolutions.
 Continuous Improvement
 Participate in initiatives to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of the design and development processes, focusing on reducing design-related risks and ensuring first-time-right product realization.
 Collect and analyze quality data from the design phase to support performance monitoring and reporting for project milestones.
 Candidate Requirements 
 Engineering degree in quality, industrial, aeronautical, or mechanical engineering.
 3 to 5 years of relevant experience in supplier / procurement quality, preferably in the aerospace, defense, or automotive sectors.
 Strong experience in Supplier audit & qualification, PPAP / FAI run, Supplier corrective action (8D)
 Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across teams and departments in an international environment.
 Open for supplier travel
 Communication & Commitment: Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; full alignment with Harmattan AI’s mission and willingness to go the extra mile to support our growth.
 We look forward to hearing how you can help shape the future of autonomous defense systems at Harmattan AI.

items.jobDescription:
Innovationen bringen tiefgreifende Veränderungen mit sich und beeinflussen unser Leben in vielfältiger Weise. Bei der TÜV SÜD Gruppe sind wir in hohem Maße bestrebt, ein wichtiger Teil dieser Entwicklung und des Fortschritts zu sein. Wir sind von Anfang an dabei und begleiten diesen Prozess. Wir sorgen für eine sichere und nachhaltige Zukunft und schaffen Vertrauen in neue Technologien. Wir beraten, wir prüfen, wir zertifizieren. Für die Sicherheit von Menschen und der Gesellschaft fordern wir uns jeden Tag aufs Neue heraus. Wir handeln aus Überzeugung, gestalten schon heute die Welt von morgen – setzen Zeichen. Wir nehmen die Zukunft in die Hand. Wir sind die TÜV SÜD Gruppe. Die TÜV SÜD Gruppe steht seit 1866 für Sicherheit, Qualität und Nachhaltigkeit und ist heute ein internationaler Dienstleistungskonzern mit weltweit 30.000 Mitarbeitenden. Unabhängig und objektiv sorgt die TÜV SÜD Gruppe für Vertrauen bei Verbraucher\*innen und Unternehmen.
### **Aufgaben**
- Fachgerechte Prüfung von Kraftfahrzeugen aller Art nach den gesetzlichen Bestimmungen an der Technischen Prüfstelle und in Werkstätten im Einsatzgebiet
- Erstellung und Durchführung von Schadensbewertungen und Änderungsgutachten nach den gesetzlichen Bestimmungen

- Pflege der vorhandenen Kundschaft und Gewinnung von Neukund\*innen
### **Qualifikation**
- Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Ingenieurwissenschaften im Bereich Fahrzeugtechnik, Maschinenbau, Elektrotechnik oder eines vergleichbaren technischen Studiengangs an einer Universität, einer Technischen Hochschule oder einer Fachhochschule
- Idealerweise erste Erfahrung im Kfz-Wesen z. B. durch vorangegangene Berufsausbildung in dem Bereich
- Leidenschaft für Fahrzeuge und Technik
- Sorgfältige Arbeitsweise, Verantwortungsbewusstsein sowie Kommunikationsstärke für den Umgang mit Kund\*innen
### Sonstige Information
Die Qualifizierung zum\*r amtlich anerkannten Sachverständigen bzw. zum\*r Prüfingenieur\*in erfolgt berufsbegleitend im Anstellungsverhältnis, d. h. wir zahlen von Anfang an ein festes Gehalt und gleichzeitig werden Sie in theoretischen und praktischen Seminaren auf die Anerkennungsprüfung intensiv vorbereitet. Die Qualifizierungskosten werden von TÜV SÜD komplett übernommen. Ebenso wird ein Teil der Kosten für den LKW-Führerschein erstattet. Wir bieten eine sichere Anstellung mit einem marktüblichen Ingenieursgehalt und der Möglichkeit auf Leistungszuschläge nach unserem Tarifvertrag mit umfassenden Sozialleistungen, betrieblicher Altersvorsorge sowie einer attraktiven Konzernerfolgsprämie. Die Arbeitszeit beträgt durchschnittlich 38,50 Stunden pro Woche, Überstunden werden mit einem Zuschlag vergütet oder können zusätzlich in Freizeit genommen werden. Nach Ihrer Ausbildung erwartet Sie ein umfassendes Programm zur Karriereplanung und -förderung bei der TÜV SÜD Gruppe. Nach Ihrer erfolgreichen Qualifizierung ist grundsätzlich auch eine Tätigkeit in Teilzeit möglich. Wir besprechen gerne Ihre individuellen Wünsche in einem persönlichen Gespräch mit Ihnen.
Weitere Informationen zum Einstieg und zur Weiterqualifizierung zum\*r Kfz-Sachverständigen finden Sie unter: [www.tuvsud.com/mobilitaetsexperten](http://www.tuvsud.com/mobilitaetsexperten).

 Dann sind Sie bei uns genau richtig.
 In der Position als Elektroniker / Techniker (m/w/d) für Test und Qualität mit Führungsperspektive übernehmen Sie eine Schlüsselrolle zwischen Fertigung, Qualitätssicherung und Kunde. Sie begleiten elektronische Baugruppen und Geräte von der Inbetriebnahme über die Prüfung bis zur Fehleranalyse und stellen sicher, dass unsere Produkte höchsten Qualitätsanforderungen entsprechen.
 Dabei arbeiten Sie nicht nur operativ in der Endprüfung, sondern gestalten aktiv unsere Prüfprozesse mit. Sie entwickeln Prüfanweisungen, betreuen Prüfmittel und Testsysteme, analysieren Qualitätsabweichungen und tragen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung unserer Fertigungs- und Qualitätsprozesse bei.
 Als EMS-Dienstleister fertigen wir hochwertige elektronische Baugruppen und Geräte für Kunden aus unterschiedlichsten Branchen. Mit Ihrem technischen Fachwissen und Ihrem Qualitätsbewusstsein leisten Sie einen entscheidenden Beitrag zur Kundenzufriedenheit und zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation.
 Darüber hinaus bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, sich schrittweise in eine Führungsrolle zu entwickeln und langfristig Verantwortung für ein Team zu übernehmen.
 Wenn Sie Freude daran haben, technische Herausforderungen zu lösen, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten und perspektivisch Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.
 Aufgaben 
 Erstellung von Prüfanweisungen nach Kundenvorgaben
 Organisation und Koordination von Arbeitsabläufen in der Endprüfung
 Aufbau, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung von Prüfmitteln, Testsystemen und Testequipment
 Analyse und Optimierung von Prüfprozessen und Arbeitsabläufen
 Durchführung von Qualitätsschulungen sowie qualitätsbezogenen Abstimmungen mit Kunden
 Bearbeitung von Reklamationen inklusive Ursachenanalyse und Ableitung geeigneter Maßnahmen (z. B. 8D-Report, 5-Why-Methode)
 Erstellung von Erstmusterprüfberichten
 Klärung technischer Fragestellungen mit Kunden
 Einarbeitung und Qualifizierung von Mitarbeitenden im Prüfbereich
 Fehlersuche, Analyse und Reparatur elektronischer Baugruppen
 Buchung und Dokumentation von Fertigungsaufträgen, Materialbewegungen und Prüfergebnissen im ERP-System
 Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Qualitäts-, Sicherheits- und ESD-Richtlinien
 Aktive Mitarbeit bei der kontinuierlichen Verbesserung von Produktions- und Prüfprozessen
 Ihre Führungsperspektive 
 Bei entsprechender Leistung und persönlicher Eignung bieten wir Ihnen die Möglichkeit, schrittweise Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen und sich zum Team Lead Produktion weiterzuentwickeln.
 Zu Ihren zukünftigen Aufgaben gehören: 
 Fachliche Führung und Unterstützung des Teams in der Endprüfung
 Planung und Koordination der täglichen Prüf- und Fertigungsabläufe
 Sicherstellung von Qualität, Produktivität und Termintreue
 Unterstützung bei der Einsatz- und Personalplanung sowie Einarbeitung neuer Mitarbeitender
 Überwachung, Auswertung und Analyse relevanter Kennzahlen

 Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Prozessen nach Lean- und KVP-Prinzipien
 Unterstützung bei der Einführung neuer Produkte, Prüfverfahren und Betriebsmittel
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Produktion, Qualitätssicherung, Entwicklung, Einkauf und Logistik
 Profil

 Sicherer Umgang mit Mess- und Prüftechnik
 Erfahrung im Aufbau, in der Wartung oder Weiterentwicklung von Prüfvorrichtungen und Testsystemen
 Gutes technisches Verständnis sowie analytische Denkweise
 Erfahrung im Lesen von Schaltplänen, Stücklisten und technischen Zeichnungen

 Idealerweise Erfahrung im Umgang mit ERP-Systemen
 Bereitschaft zur Arbeit im 2-Schicht-System
 Sicheres und professionelles Auftreten im Kundenkontakt
 Gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie grundlegende Englischkenntnisse für das technische Umfeld

 Teamorientiert, verantwortungsbewusst und lösungsorientiert

 Qualitätsbewusst und proaktiv

 Wenn Sie Interesse daran haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und sich perspektivisch in eine Führungsrolle weiterzuentwickeln, freuen wir uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen.
 Wir bieten
 Verantwortungsvolle Tätigkeit mit langfristiger Perspektive
 Gezielte Entwicklungsmöglichkeit zum Team Lead
 Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben in einem technisch anspruchsvollen Umfeld
 Kurze Entscheidungswege und viel Gestaltungsspielraum
 Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit direkten Kommunikationswegen
 Strukturierte Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten

Die Möglichkeit
 Bei Hitachi Energy arbeiten wir gemeinsam an einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die Technik nicht nur verstehen, sondern sie auch vor Ort zum Laufen bringen wollen.
Für den weiteren Ausbau unseres Servicegeschäfts im Bereich Hochspannungstechnologie suchen wir technische Talente, die wir gezielt zum Field Service Engineer entwickeln möchten.
In dieser Rolle bist du dort im Einsatz, wo moderne Energieinfrastruktur entsteht und zuverlässig funktionieren muss. Du unterstützt uns in Deutschland und, wenn es zu dir passt, auch international bei der Installation, Inbetriebnahme, Wartung und Modernisierung unserer Hochspannungs- und Hochstromanlagen.
Dabei arbeitest du mit Technologien wie AIS (Freiluftschaltanlagen), GCB (Generatorschaltern), GIS (gasisolierten Schaltanlagen), Transformatoren und Systemen der Hochspannungs-Gleichstromübertragung (HVDC). Sie bilden eine wichtige Grundlage für eine sichere und zuverlässige Energieversorgung und ermöglichen unter anderem die Integration erneuerbarer Energien sowie die effiziente Übertragung großer Energiemengen über weite Entfernungen.
Bei uns musst du nicht bereits alles können. Wir investieren in deine Entwicklung. Durch praxisnahe Einarbeitung, Trainings und Zertifizierungen baust du dein Fachwissen Schritt für Schritt aus und kannst dich langfristig zum Spezialisten für ausgewählte Hochspannungstechnologien entwickeln.
Gemeinsam gestalten wir deinen Karriereweg passend zu deinen Stärken, Interessen und persönlichen Zielen.
 Das kannst du bewirken
 Du installierst, prüfst und nimmst Hochspannungsanlagen und Energieübertragungssysteme in Betrieb, z. B. GIS, AIS, Leistungsschalter, Transformatoren, HVDC-Anlagen und Hybridlösungen.
 Du führst Wartungs- und Serviceeinsätze durch und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Anlagen langfristig sicher und zuverlässig betrieben werden können.
 Du analysierst technische Störungen, führst Diagnosen vor Ort durch und entwickelst gemeinsam mit unseren Experten passende Lösungen.
 Du unterstützt Retrofit-, Upgrade- und Modernisierungsprojekte und hilfst damit, bestehende Anlagen fit für die Zukunft zu machen.
 Du sorgst bei deinen Einsätzen konsequent für die Einhaltung unserer HSE- (Health, Safety & Environment) und Qualitätsstandards.
 Du dokumentierst deine Serviceeinsätze nachvollziehbar und erstellst die erforderlichen technischen Berichte.
 Du arbeitest eng mit unseren internen Teams zusammen und bist gleichzeitig ein kompetenter Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden vor Ort.
 Du vermittelst dein Wissen und schulst Kundenpersonal im sicheren Betrieb, in der Anwendung und in der Wartung unserer Anlagen.
 Dein Hintergrund
 Du hast eine technische Ausbildung, zum Beispiel in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder Mechatronik mit elektrotechnischem Schwerpunkt, oder verfügst über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Du begeisterst dich für anspruchsvolle Technik und möchtest dich fachlich im Bereich Hochspannung und Energieübertragung weiterentwickeln.
 Erste Erfahrungen in der Hochspannungstechnik, im Anlagenbau, in der Inbetriebnahme, Montage oder im technischen Service sind von Vorteil, aber nicht zwingend erforderlich.
 Kenntnisse rund um GIS, AIS, Transformatoren, Schaltanlagen, HVDC oder vergleichbare elektrotechnische Systeme sind ein Plus.
 Du bist gerne praktisch unterwegs und bringst Reisebereitschaft für nationale oder, je nach Spezialisierung und persönlicher Präferenz, internationale Serviceeinsätze mit.
 Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und behältst auch bei anspruchsvollen technischen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.
 Im Umgang mit Kunden trittst du professionell, verbindlich und serviceorientiert auf.
 Sicherheit, Qualität und eine gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise sind für dich selbstverständlich.
 Du kannst dich auf Deutsch und Englisch gut verständigen, idealerweise auf mindestens B2-Niveau.
 Mehr über uns

Als Field Service Engineer bist du dabei nicht nur Zuschauer, sondern arbeitest direkt an der Technik, die für die Energieversorgung von heute und morgen entscheidend ist.

items.jobTitle: Associate Project Engineer, Intralogistics (m/f/d) - Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg
items.jobDescription:
What To Expect
 Tesla is accelerating the world's transition to sustainable energy. Revolutionary strategies and products were developed within a few years and successfully launched on a large scale. This is only possible through extraordinary speed, innovation and efficiency. Gigafactory Berlin-Brandenburg forms the perfect basis for rolling out Tesla's incredible success story in Europe. The most important pillar for this are our employees. Their passion, motivation and engagement ensure that we achieve our goals. We are looking for you to continue and expand this success story together.
 The Role
 Tesla’s Intralogistics/Material Flow Operations team is responsible for the material flow between storage locations and the production line and must ensure steady and robust parts supply. The team is seeking a Logistics Project Engineer to focus on setting up, maintaining and improving our day-to-day operational processes within material flow operations. In this role, you will have ownership of projects from concept to implementation. You will function as the key liaison with logistics internal business stakeholders such as Material Handling teams on the shopfloor and Material Flow Systems Engineers but also need to closely collaborate with cross-functional teams during the development and execution of key projects and initiatives. The Logistics Project Engineer will work directly with the core management team of Material Flow Operations to drive high visibility and high value initiatives and have the ability to apply program/project management skills to assure the timely and efficient execution of a portfolio of projects.
 What You'll Do
 Identify project scope based on internal business need, proactive risk identification and cross-functional requirements that have strong impact on main KPI’s, such as attendance, safety, line supply, inventory accuracy, scrap & labor costs, etc. 
 Lead cross-functional teams/initiatives or be a strong project stakeholder to define, implement, drive and document all project requirements, milestones and deliverables and keep project plans up to date at all times, including resource allocations, tracking hours, monitoring schedules, milestones, deliverables, updating percentage completion, etc.
 Be a strong representor of Intralogistics requirements and drive constant progress with all internal stakeholders such as shop operations, process engineering, shop controls, FSI, and manufacturing engineering teams
 Become an expert & be on top of state-of-the-art Intralogistics solutions & technologies, such as AGVs/AMR’s, AI in Intralogistics, technologies & automation supporting material handlers, etc. 
 Be a strong communicator towards all relevant Intralogistics internal & external stakeholders to create highest level of transparency & be able to pull in resources fast and in an efficient way 
 Lead cross-functional teams including operations & engineering personnel. Have a strong focus on resource allocation, coordination of activities, and transparent communication of project status and risk
 Collect, analysis and visualize data to present project requirements and statuses as well as KPI’s/Reports to stakeholders & management (e.g. Excel, Ziplaps, or other dashboards & AI tools)
 Build and use relevant dashboards & AI tools, create & automate flows/tools in daily operations routines, reporting and KPI tracking to be as efficient and HC efficient as possible 
 What You'll Bring
 Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Administration, Logistics (or similar) and experience in a fast paced, highly fluid environment or other evidence of exceptional ability
 MBA or Masters in the field of Logistics or Project Management or equivalent experience is a plus 
 Familiarity with Project Management tools, methods and principles such das MS Project
 Strong MS Office (Powerpoint & Excel) skills 
 Self-organized with outstanding written and verbal communication skills
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 Demonstrated, applied experience delivering complex programs and projects
 Experience in working with shopfloor operations & engineering teams as well as management L
 Must be fluent in English & German
, Tesla

Engineer (f/m/x) - Software development of secure IP-based protocols for satellite communications (Oberpfaffenhofen)
items.jobDescription:
The Institute of Communications and Navigation, with sites in Oberpfaffenhofen and Neustrelitz, is dedicated to mission-oriented research in selcted areas of communications and navigation. These are embedded in the DLR programmes on space, aviation, transport and security.
 What to expect 
 One area of work within the Satellite Networks Division is the ‘Integrated Satellite Systems’ research group, which focuses on the design and development of new concepts for secure satellite-based communication systems and their integration with other systems, taking an application-oriented approach. As a member of the group, you will be responsible for independently and accountably carrying out tasks relating to the development of complex protocols and algorithms for satellite constellations, with a specific focus on protocol security for IETF-based technologies (e.g. TCP, IP, QUIC, HTTP, etc.). In addition, you will be required to carry out a vulnerability analysis of the protocols used for ground-to-space and space-to-space communications, as well as an analysis of potential threats at the satellite payload level with regard to the on-board instruments, processing functions and the general architecture of the spacecraft.
 Your tasks 
 Protocol and software development for secure IP-based communication in satellite constellations
 Technical point of contact in the areas of novel, efficient algorithms, protocols and software systems for satellite communications, system modelling and system simulation
 Conceptual planning, development and implementation of new and challenging research tasks in the field of complex protocols and algorithms for satellite constellations
 Carrying out performance simulations and validating the results obtained
 Application of research findings and implementation in national and international projects
 Analytical evaluation of the results obtained and publication in scientific journals and at conferences
 Your profile 
 A completed academic degree (Master’s/Diploma) in engineering (e.g. electrical engineering, information technology or telecommunications) or other relevant degree programmes
 Practical research experience (at least 2–3 years) in the design and implementation of secure IP protocols and corresponding validation in the laboratory, e.g. gained through a PhD or other proven research activities
 Extensive knowledge and many years of professional experience in the field of telecommunications engineering, particularly in the area of communication networks
 Excellent knowledge and extensive experience in the field of cybersecurity, protocol design and secure IP-based protocols for satellite systems, i.e. IPsec, QUIC, TLS, SSL, etc.
 Excellent knowledge of C++ combined with extensive professional experience in the fields of software engineering, communication protocols and network simulation / system simulation
 Excellent command of English
 Remuneration depends on qualifications and job assignment up to pay grad 14 TVöD.

 Dr. Sandro Scalise   
Tel.: +49 8153 28 2856

items.jobTitle: Application Engineer - High Performance Liquid Cooling Solutions
items.jobDescription:
We are looking for an experienced Application Engineer to be the primary technical partner for customers adopting our innovative liquid cooling products. 
 You will work directly with enterprise customers and our engineering team, translating real-world system requirements into deployment-ready solutions. This role requires sharp technical insight combined with exceptional communication to build strong partnerships. You will ensure our technology delivers clear and measurable performance benefits to our customers, directly contributing to the scaling of our high-performance solutions in complex thermal environments.
 About apheros: 
 We are a startup pioneering metal foam-based cooling solutions for AI-data centers and more. Our materials are integrated into cooling solutions for both single and two-phase direct-to-chip liquid cooling - enabling better performance, hotspot management, and energy savings. 
 Our team is built on curiosity, collaboration, and a shared drive to craft a sustainable future - while having fun along the way! Our offices, labs, and pilot line are close to the train station in Baden, Switzerland, and fully stocked with coffee and cake.
 Tasks
 Be the primary pre-sale technical lead for customers adopting our liquid cooling solutions, engaging deeply with the data center hardware ecosystem to understand detailed thermal and fluidic requirements
 Develop compelling technical use cases for our customers, as well as performance models that clearly highlight the value, efficiency, and Return on Investment (ROI) of our cooling solutions
 Drive proof-of-concept demonstrations and performance validations, showcasing how our solutions meet stringent thermal, fluidic, and operational requirements
 Collaborate closely with internal R&D and Engineering teams to ensure critical customer insights — spanning materials, thermal science, and high-performance computing needs — are accurately translated into product development
 Build and maintain strong customer relationships, acting as a trusted technical advisor who partners with clients to optimize their thermal performance and overall data center efficiency
 Requirements
 3- to 5-year experience as an application engineer, solutions engineer, or pre-sales role, specifically within data center, high-performance computing (HPC), or thermal management environments
 A strong technical understanding of liquid cooling systems and data center cooling requirements
 Excellent customer‑facing skills with a proven ability to build rapport and trust with engineers, systems architects, and executive decision‑makers
 The ability to translate customer application needs and requirements into clear, concise inputs for our Product Development and Engineering teams
 A pragmatic, collaborative, and adaptable mindset comfortable thriving in a fast-paced, startup environment focused on clear, measurable results
 What sets you apart: 
 You possess an advanced technical understanding (or degree) in thermal management, fluid dynamics, or data center infrastructure, enabling in-depth discussions about complex liquid cooling solutions
 You have a proven track record in technical sales - ideally in electronics hardware, HPC, or data center environments - with experience in driving customer adoption and leading technical sale cycles
 You genuinely care about customers’ pain points and translate them into concrete, fast-to-deploy cooling solutions
 You can work fluidly across R&D, Engineering, Product, and Marketing functions to achieve collective goals
 Benefits
 High autonomy to drive product strategy and make a direct, meaningful impact on the company's trajectory and bottom line
 Complete technical ownership of cooling solutions, from initial customer concept and design to successful deployment and post-sales validation
 A commitment to mutual support, continuous learning, and direct, constructive feedback to help you develop and grow with the company
 Flexible work arrangements supporting work-life balance
 At apheros AG, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We encourage applications from individuals of all backgrounds and fields of expertise.
 Application deadline: January 31st, 2026

Ihr persönlicher Wirkungsraum: Die Universitätsbibliothek schafft mit der Hauptbibliothek, 33 Fachbibliotheken und dem Archiv ideale Bedingungen für Forschung, Lehre und Studium an der Universität Wien. Sie gestaltet Open Science, unterstützt Wissenschaft im digitalen Wandel und fördert durch moderne Lernräume, individuelle Beratung und ein breites Workshop-Angebot Informationskompetenz und wissenschaftlichen Austausch. Sie versorgt Universitätsangehörige und die Öffentlichkeit mit über zehn Millionen Medien aus acht Jahrhunderten. 
 Ihr Arbeitsplatz ist im Team Forschungsdatenmanagement (FDM) der Universitätsbibliothek, Abteilung Forschungs- und Publikationsservices.
 Sie arbeiten direkt mit Forschungsgruppen an der Entwicklung, Weiterentwicklung und Professionalisierung wissenschaftlicher Software. Ihr Schwerpunkt liegt auf der softwaretechnischen Umsetzung in konkreten Forschungsprojekten im Bereich Scientific Computing und High Performance Computing (HPC), insbesondere bei Simulationen, Batch Computing, datenintensiven Anwendungen und GPU-Workflows. Fachlich koordiniert durch die RSE-Koordination arbeiten Sie eng mit Forschungsgruppen, Fakultäten und Zentren, Data Stewards, dem Zentralen Informatikdienst und weiteren Infrastrukturpartner*innen zusammen.
 An der Universität Wien wird derzeit das wissenschaftlich geleitete Competence Centre Scientific Computing (CCS) als fakultätsübergreifende Service- und Kompetenzstruktur für Scientific Computing aufgebaut. Ergänzend werden in einer neuen gemeinsamen Struktur von Universitätsbibliothek und Zentralem Informatikdienst technische Infrastrukturen sowie fachübergreifende Beratungs- und Serviceleistungen gebündelt und weiterentwickelt. Ihre Tätigkeit erfolgt im Rahmen dieser gemeinsamen Struktur.
 Die Stelle ist vorerst mit 12 Monaten befristet, eine Übernahme in ein unbefristetes Dienstverhältnis wird angestrebt.
Das machen Sie konkret: Bearbeitung konkreter RSE-Projekte gemeinsam mit Forschungsgruppen – von technischer Analyse und Scoping bis zur Implementierung
 Beratung von wissenschaftlichen Projekten zu Softwarearchitektur, Technologieauswahl, Entwicklungsprozessen und geeigneten Scientific-Compute-Infrastrukturen
 Weiterentwicklung und Professionalisierung von Forschungssoftware hinsichtlich Wartbarkeit, Reproduzierbarkeit, Portabilität und Performance
 Anpassung und Portierung wissenschaftlicher Software und Workflows für Linux-basierte Cluster- und HPC-Umgebungen
 Zusammenarbeit mit CCS, ZID und weiteren Infrastrukturpartner*innen bei der Einbindung von Forschungssoftware in Compute- und HPC-Umgebungen
 Identifikation wiederkehrender technischer Anforderungen und Rückmeldung an die RSE-Koordination zur Weiterentwicklung und Evaluation des RSE-Angebots
 Das gehört zu Ihrer Persönlichkeit: Abgeschlossenes einschlägiges Hochschulstudium, etwa in Informatik, Naturwissenschaften oder einem computergestützten Forschungsgebiet, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit einschlägiger Berufserfahrung
 Sehr gute praktische Softwareentwicklungskompetenz und praktische Erfahrung in der Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung wissenschaftlicher Software
 Fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Software-Engineering-Praktiken einschließlich Softwarearchitektur, Versionskontrolle, Testing, Code Review und Dokumentation
 Praktische Erfahrung mit Scientific Computing sowie HPC- oder Clusterumgebungen
 Gute Kenntnisse Linux-basierter wissenschaftlicher Computing-Umgebungen und reproduzierbarer Softwareumgebungen
 Erfahrung mit wissenschaftlichen Workflows, Simulationen oder datenintensiven Anwendungen
 Praktische Erfahrung in der Anpassung, Portierung und Weiterentwicklung von Forschungssoftware für unterschiedliche Compute- und HPC-Umgebungen
 Gute technische Beratungs- und Kommunikationskompetenz
 Eigenständige, systematische Arbeitsweise, Teamfähigkeit und Bereitschaft zur Weiterbildung
 Von Vorteil
 Erfahrung mit paralleler Programmierung, GPU-Workflows oder Performance-Analyse wissenschaftlicher Anwendungen
 Erfahrung darin, wissenschaftliche Anforderungen gemeinsam mit Forschenden in technisch tragfähige Softwarelösungen zu übersetzen
 Praxis mit Batch-Scheduling, automatisierten Build- und Testprozessen oder containerisierten Forschungsumgebungen
 Erfahrung mit Forschungssoftware in Natur- und Geowissenschaften oder Life Sciences 
 Das bieten wir Ihnen: Inspirierendes Arbeitsklima: Sie sind Teil eines engagierten Teams mit diversem universitären Background, in einer lockeren Arbeitsumgebung.
