items.jobTitle: Applications Engineering, Staff Engineer STA PrimeTime
items.jobDescription:
We Are 
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 
 You Are 
 You treat ambiguity as an invitation to bring clarity, not as a reason to slow down. Stepping into complex, high-stakes moments with a steady presence comes naturally to you. You listen carefully for what's unsaid, ask the questions that unlock momentum, and align people around the real problem, not just the loudest symptom. Tight timelines and high expectations energize you because you know how to prioritize what matters, communicate tradeoffs early, and keep progress visible without creating noise. 
 Partnership over posturing defines how you approach customers and internal teams. The back-and-forth of discovery energizes you, and you naturally translate between technical, business, and everything in between so decisions get made with confidence. You don't just deliver answers. You build trust by being transparent, direct, and constructive, especially when the message is hard. When something breaks, curiosity and methodical thinking guide you as you trace causes with patience while keeping the bigger picture in view. 
 Constantly looking for leverage is part of who you are. Patterns reveal themselves to you, one-off fixes become repeatable playbooks, and you leave behind cleaner processes than you found. Precision balanced with pragmatism helps you know when to go deep and when to move forward with a well-framed assumption. Above all, you bring a collaborative intensity that is calm, driven, and generous, helping the team move faster together while keeping quality and integrity non-negotiable. Your job location will be in Hyderabad. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Support Synopsys PrimeTime Static Timing Analysis tool across pre-sale evaluations, post-sale deployments, and ongoing customer engagements
 Drive product adoption by running competitive benchmarks, leading customer evaluations, and articulating technical advantages to design teams and engineering management
 Deliver customer training sessions, technical presentations, and hands-on workshops that maximize user proficiency and satisfaction with PrimeTime
 Provide tape-out support by troubleshooting complex timing issues, resolving signal integrity problems, and ensuring successful project completion under deadline pressure
 Collaborate with R&D, product marketing, and sales teams to relay customer feedback, influence product enhancements, and shape roadmap priorities
 Develop and maintain technical documentation, best practices guides, and knowledge base resources that scale your expertise across the customer base
 Participate in advanced customer collaboration initiatives that drive innovation, uncover new use cases, and strengthen long-term partnerships
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Accelerate customer project timelines by enabling efficient use of PrimeTime and optimizing design flows that remove timing closure bottlenecks
 Enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty through expert support, proactive problem-solving, and training that builds internal capability
 Strengthen Synopsys' leadership in static timing analysis and semiconductor design solutions by delivering measurable wins in competitive engagements
 Facilitate feedback loops between customers and internal teams that drive continuous innovation in product features, usability, and performance
 Empower customers to achieve superior chip performance, power efficiency, and cost optimization that directly affect their product success
 Contribute to successful tape-outs and high-impact design wins for industry-leading clients building next-generation silicon
 Build reusable methodologies and documentation that multiply your impact across the global customer base and internal teams
 What You'll Need 
 Deep hands-on expertise in Synopsys PrimeTime STA tool, including advanced features, timing analysis methodologies, and real-world application across multiple design nodes
 Strong understanding of timing corners, process variations, signal integrity issues, and how they affect timing closure in modern semiconductor designs
 Familiarity with synthesis, physical design, extraction, and ECO methodologies, and how they integrate with static timing analysis workflows
 Proficiency in TCL scripting for automation, tool customization, and workflow optimization
 Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience in customer-facing roles, experience delivering technical training or presentations is a plus
 BSEE or equivalent with 5+ years of relevant experience, or MSEE or equivalent with 3-4 years of experience in applications engineering, design, or verification roles
 Who You Are 
 You collaborate naturally, valuing diverse perspectives and fostering environments where different technical viewpoints strengthen the outcome
 Proactive problem-solving defines your approach. You work independently, manage multiple priorities without losing threads, and know when to escalate or pull in help
 Adaptable and resilient, you thrive when priorities shift, timelines compress, or technical challenges require creative thinking under pressure
 Detail-oriented with a commitment to delivering high-quality results, you catch the edge cases and corner conditions that others miss
 You can explain a complex timing closure tradeoff to a customer VP in two sentences without losing the nuance, and then turn around and debug a TCL script with an engineer
 You notice when a customer question signals a deeper workflow issue, and you address both the immediate ask and the underlying gap
 The Team You'll Be Part Of 
 You'll join a talented applications engineering team that supports the industry-leading Static Timing Analysis tool, PrimeTime. The team's core purpose is to drive increased product usage, ensure customer success, and collaborate closely with R&D, marketing, and sales to foster innovation. Together, you will enable customers to build next-generation silicon chips faster and more efficiently, playing a vital role in Synopsys' global leadership in chip design and verification. 
 Rewards and Benefits 
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 
 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

 As a Forward Deployed Engineer at deepset, you work embedded inside our most strategic Enterprise and Public Sector customers, as part of their team. You are the technical partner the customer relies on day to day, and the bridge between their teams and deepset’s Customer Engineering, Product and Engineering teams.
 Why deepset 
 At deepset, we're on a mission to make custom AI solutions accessible to every organization. With Haystack, thousands of developers build advanced LLM applications every day, while our enterprise-ready AI Platform helps companies turn large language models into business value. We're remote-first, flexible, and built on a culture of trust and ownership. You'll collaborate with top-tier tech talent, tackle meaningful challenges, and help transform complex AI into solutions that are simple, powerful, and ready for the real world.
 What you will do 
 Embed and partner 
 Work inside the customer’s team, aligned with their delivery and governance models, ways of working and environments.
 Act as the customer’s trusted AI advisor on use case prioritization, architecture and roadmap, connecting their goals with the Haystack Enterprise Platform (HEP).
 Translate business problems into well-scoped solutions with clear success metrics and a baseline, together with the Value Engineer.
 Anticipate upcoming needs and maintain a customer-specific AI roadmap.
 Build and run in production 
 Own technical outcomes from PoC to production: agents and orchestration, workflows, RAG pipelines, indexing and embeddings, model optimization, evaluations, cost management, and API and system integrations.
 Bring state-of-the-art approaches to the customer’s hardest problems and turn them into reliable, secure, production-grade systems inside the customer’s environment.
 Monitor solution performance with the customer and resolve issues in the AI layer quickly.
 Reuse and contribute reference architectures and reusable components that make every new engagement faster.
 Drive adoption and impact 
 Make sure what you build is actually used, with measurable quality and business impact.
 Run structured evaluations and continuously improve retrieval quality, prompts and model behavior based on real usage and feedback.
 Enable the customer team to operate and extend solutions independently: documentation, runbooks, knowledge transfer and training.
 Grow the account and the product 
 Surface new use cases, teams and stakeholders, and bring them to the account team.
 Prepare the evidence for the contract renewal: value delivered against the baseline agreed at kick-off.
 Share field insights with Product and Engineering to shape HEP.
 What you bring to the team 
 Native German language skills 
 Hands-on experience shipping AI applications to production: RAG, agents, data preprocessing, retrieval and embeddings.
 A track record of building trusted, long-term relationships with technical and business stakeholders, communicating clearly at every level.
 Experience designing and running agent evaluations and improving quality from real usage data.
 Familiarity with agent frameworks and vector databases.
 Strong Python and production engineering practices: testing, CI/CD, code review and observability.
 Experience operating AI solutions in production in enterprise environments: monitoring, troubleshooting and incident handling.
 Solid understanding of enterprise integration: APIs, authentication (OIDC/SAML), security and compliance.
 Close awareness of the state of the art in LLMs and agentic systems, and the judgment to know when it is ready for production.
 Experience scoping and estimating work within long-running engagements: effort, assumptions, risks and deliverables.

 Forward-deployed or consulting experience on long, embedded engagements

 Fine-tuning experience (PEFT, LoRA)
 Benefits

 Annual learning & development budget

 Dog-friendly Berlin HQ

At Luscii, we work on several applications within the OMRON Digital Health Circle, including the Luscii Thuismeten app and OMRON Connect. As an Android Developer at Luscii, you will build and improve the mobile applications that make this possible.
 Your work goes beyond writing code. You will help shape technical direction, share your expertise with colleagues and explore new technologies that can improve our apps. At Luscii, our Holacratic way of working also gives you the autonomy to take initiative, pick up responsibilities and contribute beyond your core role.
 The applications you build need to work reliably in a healthcare context, where stability and usability matter. You are going to make sure that our apps remain performant, scalable and easy to maintain, while exploring new ways to improve the experience for patients and healthcare professionals. By combining solid engineering with thoughtful technical choices, you will help us continue to develop its digital healthcare platform.
 Your role
 As Android Developer at Luscii, you will combine hands-on development with technical ownership, working closely with colleagues across development, QA and support to build, improve and maintain our applications. You turn ideas into useful, intuitive digital health solutions. Whether you are exploring a new technology, building a proof of concept or solving a production issue, you will have the autonomy to make technical decisions and the opportunity to influence how we build our apps.
 What you will be doing:
 Develop and optimise Android applications in Kotlin, with a focus on performance, stability and user experience.
 Shape mobile architecture and technical solutions, applying sound software design principles and patterns.
 Build prototypes and proof of concepts to explore ideas and validate technical approaches early.
 Develop features that communicate with Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) devices.
 Investigate and resolve production issues, using debugging and performance analysis to keep our apps reliable.
 Review code, share technical guidelines and collaborate with development, QA and support colleagues.
 Explore relevant developments in mobile technology, including Jetpack Compose and Kotlin Multiplatform, and recommend improvements where they add value.
 Why Luscii?
 Read more about working at Luscii and how we work at Luscii/OMRON. Together, we are working on a mission to create space for care. Freedom, autonomy and ownership are of great importance in this. You are responsible for your own results and work according to the principles of Holacracy.
 Most important benefits
 Salary : € 4.600 - € 5.900 gross per month (based on 32 hours per week – that’s full-time at Luscii).
 Remote-first : Work from anywhere in The Netherlands. We stay connected through monthly in-person team days called Assemblii .
 Flexible setup : Create your own ideal workspace. Whatever works best for you - we’ve got you covered here.
 The ideal candidate…
 … probably doesn't exist, but if you can tick most of the checkboxes below, please apply! We are looking for somebody who is comfortable in taking ownership and making well-considered decisions independently. You enjoy the autonomy to shape your work and responsibilities, while actively seeking collaboration and alignment with others.
 You know when to step up, when to involve colleagues and when to move forward decisively. Working independently does not mean working in isolation for you. You feel at ease being both a self-starter and a committed team player, contributing to shared goals while taking responsibility for your own domain. You value open communication, transparency, and mutual trust.
 You have at least five years of experience in Android or mobile development and extensive experience with Kotlin, including coroutines and Flow.
 You have a relevant bachelor’s degree in e.g. Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a comparable field, combined with experience working in an Agile environment.
 You have experience with clean architecture, software design patterns and approaches such as MVVM or MVI, and you understand how to apply them in maintainable mobile applications.
 You have experience with Jetpack Compose, mobile unit and/or UI testing, CI/CD pipelines and Android design guidelines.
 You understand mobile performance and reliability, including memory management, multithreading, networking, debugging and optimisation, as well as working with web services, cloud platforms and APIs.
 You are open to working in a Holacratic organization and curious about our way of organizing work, roles, and responsibilities;

About the team 
 The AI Deployment Engineering team works closely with frontier startups. We are trusted advisors to, and thought partners with, startups to ensure that OpenAI’s technology is deployed safely and effectively, whilst also partnering with engineering, research, and product to turn those insights into evaluation systems, product improvements, and better model behavior.
 This team sits at the intersection of customer reality and model quality. We combine hands-on technical depth with strong product judgment, helping translate complex, high-value use cases into clear signals that can improve both the customer experience and the underlying systems.
 About the role 
 We are seeking a technically proficient, product-minded engineer to help push the frontier of advanced AI with our strategic startup customers. You'll work with some of the most exciting AI startups in the world, helping them optimize their own systems and turning those learnings into durable improvements across OpenAI’s research and products. You will partner deeply on complex workflows, identify the gaps that matter, and help transform those gaps into reproducible evaluations, technical insights - helping shape OpenAI's research and product direction.
 This role is well suited to engineers who are equally comfortable debugging a workflow, iterating on prompts or agents, designing evaluations, and collaborating across research and product. You should be excited by ambiguous, high-impact problems and motivated by the opportunity to shape how advanced AI systems improve in practice.
 This role is based in Israel. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week. We offer relocation assistance. 
 In this role, you will: 
 Work directly with strategic startup customers to understand critical workflows, uncover failure modes, and identify high-impact opportunities for improvement.
 Prototype and iterate on prompts, agents, and workflow designs to better understand system behavior and unlock customer value.
 Synthesize and deliver valuable feedback to the Product and Research teams, turning real usage patterns into clear, reproducible evals, benchmarks, and technical artifacts that improve model and product quality and ensure customer-grounded learnings influence roadmap and model development.
 Build repeatable tools, patterns, and evaluation approaches that raise the quality bar across multiple use cases.
 Operate with strong judgment in ambiguous environments, balancing immediate technical problem-solving with longer-term system improvement.
 Build relationships within the startup ecosystem, serving as a technical partner to both individual customers and the broader community.
 You’ll thrive in this role if you: 
 Have strong software engineering & AI fundamentals. For example, experience as a startup CTO, software engineer, ML engineer, Data Scientist or equivalent. Experience shipping production systems end-to-end is a strong plus.
 Have experience as a technical founder, or engineer at an early stage startup
 Have familiarity with, or interest in, model training pipelines and reinforcement learning.
 Have experience building AI applications, agents, or evaluation systems, and can reason clearly about model behavior in complex workflows.
 Are comfortable working directly with highly technical users and translating their challenges into concrete technical signals.
 Can move fluidly between prototyping, debugging, evaluation design, and cross-functional collaboration.
 Communicate clearly across technical and non-technical audiences.
 Bring high agency, strong product sense, and a bias toward building durable improvements rather than one-off fixes

 OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity.

We Are 
 Synopsys is the leader in engineering solutions from silicon to systems, enabling customers to rapidly innovate AI-powered products. We deliver industry-leading silicon design, IP, simulation and analysis solutions, and design services. We partner closely with our customers across a wide range of industries to maximize their R&D capability and productivity, powering innovation today that ignites the ingenuity of tomorrow. 
 You Are 
 You are a digital design engineer who takes pride in delivering RTL that is not only functionally correct, but also clean, synthesizable, and ready for real silicon. You enjoy working through the details—timing, CDC, lint, and design quality—because you know they matter when IP ships in customer products. 
 You work well in a collaborative, global environment. You communicate openly with design, verification, and implementation teammates, ask thoughtful questions when specs are unclear, and are willing to learn new tools and methodologies, including AI-driven design approaches. Whether you are deepening your expertise or guiding others through complex challenges, you bring ownership, curiosity, and a practical mindset to your work. 
 What You'll Be Doing 
 Understand industry standards and functional specifications, and contribute to architecture and micro-architecture definitions for complex protocol IP cores 
 Design and implement RTL for digital blocks and subsystems in Verilog/SystemVerilog, balancing performance, area, power, synthesizability, and testability 
 Perform basic verification and collaborate with verification teams on test planning, assertion development, functional debug, and coverage closure 
 Perform RTL-level timing analysis during RTL development, and collaborate with implementation teams on STA, timing constraints, and synthesis as needed 
 Support CDC/RDC/Lint signoff readiness and collaborate on design-quality closure 
 Apply and explore AI-driven design tools and methodologies to improve design quality and automation 
 The Impact You Will Have 
 Your RTL will directly influence the quality and time-to-market of Synopsys IP used by semiconductor companies worldwide 
 You will reduce iteration cycles between front-end and back-end teams by delivering synthesis-ready, timing-aware designs 
 Your collaboration will catch issues earlier, reducing costly respins and late-stage fixes 
 The automation you build will improve design productivity for your team and beyond 
 Your attention to CDC/RDC/Lint readiness will strengthen product quality and reduce signoff risk 
 What You'll Need 
 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field 
 4+ years of experience in digital design and/or RTL development 
 Hands-on experience designing and implementing synthesizable RTL in Verilog/SystemVerilog, with understanding of performance, area, power, and testability tradeoffs 
 Experience with test planning, assertion development, basic verification, functional debug, and coverage closure 
 Experience performing RTL-level timing analysis, with practical understanding of STA, timing constraints, and synthesis 
 Experience with CDC/RDC/Lint signoff-ready design practices and design-quality closure 
 Scripting experience in Python, Tcl, Perl, or Shell 
 Written and oral communication skills in English and Japanese, with the ability to collaborate effectively across teams 
 Nice to Have 
 Direct experience with PCIe or CXL IP design and development 
 Experience with low-power design and power intent development using UPF 
 Exposure to UVM or formal verification concepts 
 Exposure to functional safety concepts, ISO 26262, or FMEDA 
 Experience mentoring engineers or serving as a technical lead on RTL/IP development projects 
 Prior experience in a global product engineering environment 
 Who You Are 
 You take ownership of your work and follow through on issues until they are properly resolved 
 You collaborate openly across teams and communicate clearly in both Japanese and English 
 You stay curious and adapt quickly to new tools, flows, and technical challenges 
 You balance attention to detail with practical judgment—you know when to dig deep and when to ask for help 
 You share knowledge with teammates and contribute to a supportive, learning-oriented team culture 
 The Team You'll Be Part Of 
 Your recruiter will share more about the team structure and mission during the interview process. 
 Rewards and Benefits 
 We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process. 
 At Synopsys, we want talented people of every background to feel valued and supported to do their best work. Synopsys considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, military veteran status, or disability.

Bei Endress+Hauser geschieht Fortschritt durch Zusammenarbeit. Als weltweit führender Anbieter von Messgeräten gestalten unsere über 18.000 Mitarbeitenden die Zukunft im Bereich der Prozessautomatisierung. Ob bei der Entwicklung und Umsetzung neuer Technologien, der gemeinsamen Arbeit an innovativen Geräten oder der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen globalen Industrien: Unsere Arbeit basiert auf vertrauensvollen Beziehungen, die uns gemeinsam erfolgreich machen. Als familiengeführtes Unternehmen schauen wir über kurzfristige Ziele hinaus und verfolgen eine nachhaltige Vision für unsere Mitarbeitenden, unsere Kundinnen und Kunden und die Welt im Allgemeinen.
Wir suchen einen SMT Operator (m/w/d) in der Elektronikfertigung , der unsere moderne SMT-Fertigung zuverlässig betreut und aktiv weiterentwickelt. Bei Endress+Hauser Liquid Analysis entwickeln und produzieren wir innovative Messtechnik, die unter anderem dazu beiträgt, die Qualität von Wasser und anderen Flüssigkeiten zuverlässig zu überwachen.
 Worum geht es in der Stelle?
 Begeistern Sie sich für moderne Elektronikfertigung? Möchten Sie anspruchsvolle Produktionsprozesse zuverlässig steuern und kontinuierlich verbessern? Haben Sie Freude daran, neue Produkte und Technologien erfolgreich in die Serienfertigung zu überführen? In dieser Position sorgen Sie gemeinsam mit den Bereichen Entwicklung, Industrial Engineering und Qualitätssicherung dafür, dass hochwertige Elektronikbaugruppen effizient und qualitätsgerecht gefertigt werden. Die Stelle ist innerhalb der Elektronikfertigung von Endress+Hauser Liquid Analysis am Standort Gerlingen angesiedelt.
 Welche Aufgaben werden Sie übernehmen?
 Sie werden:
 eine vollautomatische SMT-Fertigungslinie bedienen, einrichten und warten.
 einen störungsfreien und qualitätsgerechten Produktionsablauf sicherstellen.
 neue Produkte in die SMT-Fertigung einführen und deren Industrialisierung begleiten.
 Maschinen- und Produktionsprogramme sowie SPI- und AOI-Prüfprogramme erstellen, optimieren und pflegen.
 Prozessstörungen analysieren, beheben und nachhaltige Korrekturmaßnahmen einleiten.
 Prozesse, Qualität und Produktivität gemeinsam mit angrenzenden Bereichen kontinuierlich verbessern sowie Projekte zur Digitalisierung, Automatisierung und Einführung neuer Fertigungstechnologien unterstützen.
 Was erwarten wir von Ihnen?
 Sie:
 verfügen über eine technische Berufsausbildung, idealerweise im Bereich Elektronik, Mechatronik, Industrietechnik oder in einem vergleichbaren Fachgebiet.
 bringen Berufserfahrung in der SMT-Fertigung oder Elektronikproduktion mit.
 kennen sich mit SMT-Bestückungssystemen sowie mit Löt- und Inspektionsprozessen aus.
 haben idealerweise Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Maschinen-, SPI- und AOI-Programmen.
 arbeiten technisch versiert, strukturiert und lösungsorientiert und gehen sicher mit MS Office sowie gängiger Produktionssoftware um.
 übernehmen Verantwortung, arbeiten gern im Team und behalten auch in anspruchsvollen Situationen den Überblick.
 bringen Eigeninitiative und die Bereitschaft mit, sich persönlich und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
 sind bereit, im Schichtsystem (derzeit Früh- und Spätschicht) zu arbeiten.
 Was können Sie von uns erwarten?
 Wir:
 sind ein familiäres, kollegiales und hoch motiviertes Team.
 fördern lebenslanges Lernen mit vielseitigen Aus- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten.
 entwickeln nachhaltige Produkte, zum Beispiel zur Sicherstellung von sauberem Trinkwasser.
 unterstützen Ihr Wohlbefinden durch ein ganzheitliches Gesundheitsmanagement.
 bieten Ihnen ein modernes Arbeitsumfeld mit viel Raum für Eigenverantwortung und Innovation.
 Wie bewerben Sie sich?
 Um sich zu bewerben, bitten wir Sie, Ihre Unterlagen auf unserer Karriereseite hochzuladen. Bewerbungen, die uns per E-Mail erreichen, können aus Datenschutzgründen leider nicht berücksichtigt werden.
Agenturen, Personaldienstleister oder ähnliche Unternehmen werden gebeten, von der unaufgeforderten Übermittlung von Profilen und Anfragen zu einer möglichen Zusammenarbeit abzusehen. Derzeit arbeiten wir für diese Stelle nicht mit externen Dienstleistern zusammen. Alle unaufgeforderten Bewerbungen von Dienstleisternwerden nicht berücksichtigt und ohne weitere Prüfung gelöscht. Wir bedanken uns für Ihr Verständnis.

Du möchtest moderne Anwendungen entwickeln und digitale Prozesse mitgestalten? Für unseren Mandanten, ein Softwareunternehmen mit Fokus auf die Digitalisierung betrieblicher Abläufe, suchen wir einen Full Stack Entwickler (m/w/d).
 Dich erwartet ein agiles Team, das sich gegenseitig unterstützt, neue Technologien einsetzt und gemeinsam innovative Softwarelösungen entwickelt.
 Deine Aufgaben:
 Du gestaltest die Architektur und Konzeption von Web- und Mobile-Applikationen mit.
 Du begleitest den gesamten Entwicklungszyklus – von der Konzeption und dem Design über Implementierung und Dokumentation bis zu Tests und Deployment.
 Du entwickelst bestehende Softwareprodukte weiter und übernimmst deren Wartung und Pflege.
 Du sicherst die Softwarequalität durch automatisierte Tests im Frontend und Backend.
 Du unterstützt Kunden bei technischen Fragen rund um die Anwendungen.
 Dein Profil:
 Abgeschlossenes Informatikstudium, eine Ausbildung im IT-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
 Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Entwicklung von Webapplikationen.
 Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Java und TypeScript sowie Erfahrung mit Angular und Spring Boot.
 Sicherer Umgang mit modernen Entwicklungswerkzeugen und -prozessen sowie SQL-Datenbanken, beispielsweise Oracle oder H2.
 Gute Kenntnisse in Testframeworks wie Cypress und Erfahrung mit automatisierten Tests auf unterschiedlichen Ebenen.
 Idealerweise Erfahrung mit CI/CD, Git und REST-Schnittstellen.
 Erfahrung in der agilen Zusammenarbeit sowie Freude daran, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.
 Eine selbstständige, kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise, Teamgeist und analytisches Denkvermögen.
 Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse.
 Das erwartet dich:
 Unbefristete Festanstellung mit attraktiver, leistungsgerechter Vergütung.
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice zu arbeiten.
 Betriebliche Altersvorsorge und zusätzliche Leistungen, beispielsweise Fahrradleasing, Fitness- und Betreuungskostenzuschüsse sowie Mitarbeiterrabatte.
 Ein kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Wegen und gegenseitiger Unterstützung.
 Gemeinsame Teamaktivitäten und Firmenevents.
 Eine Kantine vor Ort.
 Interesse? Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Kontaktaufnahme und deinen Lebenslauf. Weitere Informationen zum Unternehmen und zur Position erhältst du im persönlichen Gespräch.

Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d)
 Remote in Germany, Austria, Spain, Portugal, Italy, the Netherlands or the UK · Full-time · Engineering, Interoperability team
 About Recare
 As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.
 What to expect as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):
 Purposeful work – your role will have a positive impact on patients, their families, and healthcare professionals.
 Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.
 Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.
 Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.
 Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.
 In this role, you can make an impact and grow with us as Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):
 Hospital staff still spend hours typing the same patient data into different systems. Our in-house RPA tool ends that: it automates hospital information systems (HIS) on Windows desktops so our data lands in patient forms automatically. We don't use UiPath or Blue Prism. We build our own engine in TypeScript, on Electron and Node with native Windows bindings.
 You'll join the Interoperability team as a hands-on engineer. Your main focus is the engine itself; everything else builds on it.
 You build, extend and stabilize the core of our RPA engine.
 You make automations reliable in hospital environments we don't fully control, with remote updates and failure monitoring.
 You automate HIS applications on Windows, including the hard legacy cases: UI Automation, Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or the browser where the app runs locally.
 You solve the Citrix problem. Most hospitals serve their HIS through Citrix, where all we see is pixels, so you work with OCR, image anchors, mouse and keyboard input, and the redraw, scrolling and display-scaling issues that come with them.
 You help extend the engine with new capabilities such as document extraction and voice input.
 You set up the rollout process with our implementation team: installers, code signing and autostart in locked-down hospital IT, and fixing problems on machines you can't log into.
 You protect health data by applying security best practices and complying with privacy regulations.
 Here's how we picture you as our Software Engineer – Desktop Automation / RPA (m/w/d):
 You have 5+ years of relevant industry experience and have built automation software that runs in production, not only configured bots in an RPA product.
 You write strong TypeScript or similar 
 You have automated Windows desktop applications with UI Automation, plus at least one of Java Access Bridge, SAP GUI Scripting or browser automation over CDP, and native interop (Node native addons, C# or C++).
 You have experience with image-based automation over Citrix or RDP (OCR, screen anchors), or a strong wish to learn it. UiPath or Blue Prism developers with Citrix or computer-vision experience who now want to build the engine are very welcome.
 You know how to keep automations reliable in production: monitoring, failure handling, updates, and testing against apps you can't run in CI.
 You communicate clearly in English with technical and non-technical people, and you're comfortable working with German-language software.
 You analyze problems thoroughly and drive them to resolution.
 Nice to have: experience with OCR, document extraction or speech-to-text; healthcare or HIS integration experience; knowledge of GDPR and sensitive data; spoken German, which helps during rollout with hospital IT.
 Not a perfect match on every point? We care more about shared drive and a real sense of mission than about ticking every box.
 If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

 Data Quality & Operations

 What we’re looking for in our next teammate    
 3+ years of experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or software engineering with a focus on data.

 Applicaties betrouwbaar laat functioneren. Je beheert verschillende bedrijfsapplicaties, ondersteunt gebruikers en zorgt ervoor dat incidenten en verstoringen effectief worden opgelost.

About Motorway 
 Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.
 This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.
 We're looking for a Staff Frontend Engineer to help lead technically across our frontend engineering. You'll work across a group of cross-functional squads, each made up of engineers, designers, data analysts and a product manager, helping them move quickly and safely, resolving the engineering problems that span teams before they compound into systemic risk, and shaping product and business strategy with a technically-grounded, commercially-aware point of view.
 We're a TypeScript-first organisation. Our frontend stack is TypeScript and React, styled with SCSS, server-side rendered with Next.js and Express, and tested with Vitest & Chromatic. As a Staff engineer you'll bring deep expertise with the latest native web technologies and modern frameworks, drive consistency across all of our web properties, and lead the migration efforts that keep our stack current, not just bumping versions, but making use of the new capabilities each release brings and helping the wider department do the same.
 At Motorway, we know the importance of delivering high-quality, valuable solutions quickly, and we recognise the ability for AI tools and agents to accelerate our work. We provide our engineers with access to the latest models through Kiro. As a Staff engineer you'll define and lead our AI engineering practice on the frontend, setting standards for agent execution environments, quality harnesses, and guardrail architecture - and build a team norm where domain depth, AI-enabled breadth, and rigorous feedback-loop design are treated as complementary.
 What you'll be doing 
 Ship features end to end : Own meaningful pieces of product work from design handoff through to production, building accessible, performant components, wiring them into applications, and shipping them with confidence.
 Author the contracts and the roadmap : Author and own API contracts and documentation for the department, and maintain a technical roadmap with rigorous written framing - precise intent, explicit trade-offs, and unambiguous success criteria - setting the documentation and spec-writing standard for the area.
 Drive consistency and lead migrations : Drive consistency across all our web properties, design the standards the department builds on, and lead migration efforts - making full use of new framework features and bringing the rest of engineering along with you.
 Own quality, security, performance and reliability standards : Set and maintain the security & web performance standards for the frontend, including client-side concerns like CSP, CWV, XSS prevention, data, governance plus reliability standards, incident review culture, and production readiness criteria.
 Own the build and deployment story : Understand the build and deployment pipeline for our assets and services end to end, monitor and improve it, and make informed, commercially-aware decisions about hosting providers, vendors, and build-vs-buy trade-offs.
 Develop other engineers : Develop IC3 engineers into technical leaders, raise the technical bar in hiring by defining what "good" looks like in the discipline, and build a culture of ownership, accountability, and high standards.
 Lead AI-assisted engineering : Use Kiro and other AI tools to move faster, and set the standards for how the team integrates AI into its everyday workflow and its products.
 What you'll have 
 Minimum requirements 
 At least 5+ years of experience in focused frontend practice building and operating production web applications at scale, with a track record of leading large, complex projects.
 The ability to bridge engineering and product fluently, translating between business priorities and technical constraints in both directions, and to make and defend difficult technical decisions under uncertainty through reasoning, not authority.
 Recognised as a technical authority in frontend engineering - engineers and product stakeholders seek you out for technical direction, and your judgement shapes decisions beyond your immediate team.
 Deep expertise with modern CSS/SCSS, HTML, and current ECMAScript proposals, and a strong understanding of the trade-offs between different frameworks and the scenarios in which each is the right choice.
 Comprehensive experience writing unit and E2E tests, and building the CI workflows to exercise them.
 Deep working knowledge of TypeScript and modern React (hooks, component composition, transitions), and of frameworks like Next.js that handle SSR, routing, and data fetching.
 Deep experience with observability, Core Web Vitals, accessibility auditing, and frontend performance tuning - and the ability to evaluate new frameworks and identify where we gain an edge in development, deployment, rendering, integration, and performance.
 Breadth across different teams, and the judgement to make pragmatic build-vs-refactor-vs-replace calls informed by a track record of production crises and scale challenges.
 A genuine interest in leading AI-assisted development as part of your and the team's workflow.
 Additional or preferred requirements 
 Experience owning and maintaining a design system, and driving its adoption across multiple teams.
 The ability to create sensible UI designs without a Designer for non-trivial (though not highly complex) work when the team is resource-constrained.
 Experience evaluating vendors and third-party tools, and making build-vs-buy recommendations with clear technical and commercial criteria.
 Experience maintaining and evolving complex legacy systems at scale.
 Backend fluency - you don't need to be full-stack, but you're comfortable following a request deep into the API layer and shaping the contract on both sides.

🚀 Présentation de Scalian
Rejoindre Scalian , c’est intégrer un groupe de conseil et d'ingénierie indépendant, acteur de référence dans le numérique, la gestion de projets et l'ingénierie des systèmes. Sur notre agence en région PACA, nous intervenons auprès d'acteurs majeurs de l'industrie aéronautique et des systèmes embarqués.
 Job Description
 Rattaché(e) au projet et intégré(e) au sein d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, vous intervenez sur tout le cycle de vie des bancs de test et des systèmes à valider. Vos principales responsabilités sont :
 Conception et architecture des bancs de test : Participer à la définition, à la spécification et à la mise en œuvre des bancs d'intégration et de validation (matériels et logiciels). 
 Intégration système : Assembler et configurer les éléments matériels et logiciels du banc de test pour assurer leur bon fonctionnement. 
 Vérification et Validation (IVV) : Rédiger et exécuter les procédures de tests (fonctionnels et de performance) sur banc, analyser les résultats et identifier les écarts. 
 Gestion des anomalies : Remonter, documenter et suivre les anomalies détectées via les outils de gestion de configuration, puis participer aux expertises techniques. 
 Maintien en Conditions Opérationnelles (MCO) : Assurer l'évolution, la maintenance et l'optimisation des bancs de test tout au long du projet. 
 Relation technique : Interagir régulièrement avec les équipes conception, développement et les clients pour garantir la conformité des livrables. 
 Qualifications
 Formation : De formation supérieure Bac+5 (École d'ingénieurs ou Master universitaire) en Électronique, Informatique Industrielle, Automatisme ou Génie Électrique. 
 Expérience : Une première expérience significative (stage, alternance ou premier emploi de 1 à 3 ans) dans le domaine de l'IVV, idéalement sur des bancs de test en environnement exigeant (Aéronautique, Spatial, Défense, Ferroviaire, Automobile ou Énergie). 
 Compétences techniques clés :
 Maîtrise des langages de script/programmation (Python, C/C++, LabVIEW, etc.). 
 Connaissance des outils de gestion de tests et de traçabilité (Jira, DOORS, TestLink...). 
 Bonnes notions en instrumentation, bus de communication (ARINC, CAN, Ethernet...) et lecture de schémas électriques.

Intro

Dabei setzen wir auf smarte Logistik, Digitalisierung, Diagnostik und individuelle Prävention. Wir denkenGesundheitsversorgung und Diagnostik neu und hinterfragen dazu stets den Status Quo.

Darüber hinaus unterstützen wir Patienten bereits heute mit modernen Lösungen zur medizinisch begleiteten Gewichtsreduktion. Perspektivisch planen wir, unser Angebot um weitere Präventions- und Gesundheitsleistungen zu erweitern, um noch mehr Menschen individuell auf ihrem Weg zu mehr Gesundheit und Lebensqualität zu begleiten.
 Du hast Spaß daran, mit Daten zu arbeiten, komplexe Zusammenhänge zu verstehen und daraus saubere Datenstrukturen zu entwickeln? In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit unserem erfahrenen Data Engineer zusammen, entwickelst Datenmodelle und schaffst die Grundlage für aussagekräftige Dashboards und datenbasierte Entscheidungen. Dabei bekommst du die Möglichkeit, dich fachlich weiterzuentwickeln und Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung im Data Engineering zu übernehmen. 
 Deine Mission bei uns
 Du entwickelst und pflegst Datenmodelle im Data Vault, indem du mit dbt Hubs, Links und Satellites für bestehende und neue Datenquellen erstellst.

 Du lernst den Betrieb unserer Datenplattform kennen und unterstützt zunehmend bei Monitoring, Fehleranalyse und dem Wiederanlauf von Datenpipelines.
 Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Data Engineer zusammen, profitierst von Pairing und Code-Reviews und übernimmst schrittweise mehr Verantwortung für unsere Dateninfrastruktur.
 Was du mitbringen solltest
 Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet. Auch motivierte Quereinsteiger:innen mit entsprechenden praktischen Kenntnissen sind willkommen.

 Du bringst grundlegende Python-Kenntnisse mit, beispielsweise für kleinere Skripte oder die Verarbeitung von Daten.
 Du hast ein grundlegendes Verständnis von Datenmodellierung, beispielsweise im Umgang mit Fakten und Dimensionen oder relationalen Datenbanken und Normalisierung.
 Du konntest bereits erste praktische Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Daten sammeln, beispielsweise durch ein Praktikum, eine Werkstudententätigkeit, Studienprojekte oder eigene Projekte.
 Du hast Lust, dich in neue Technologien und Konzepte einzuarbeiten und dich fachlich im Bereich Data Engineering weiterzuentwickeln.

 Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, da unsere Zusammenarbeit im Team überwiegend auf Deutsch stattfindet.
 Nice to have
 Du hast bereits erste Berührungspunkte mit dbt, Airflow oder Spark gesammelt.

About Suffolk: 
 Suffolk is a national enterprise that builds, innovates, and invests. We provide value across the entire project lifecycle through our core construction management services and complementary business lines in real estate investment, design, self-perform construction, and technology start-up investment through Suffolk Technologies.
 With more than $10 billion in annual revenue and projects across healthcare, life sciences, higher education, mission critical, aviation, transportation, commercial, and other complex sectors, Suffolk is redefining how America builds through innovation, technology, and operational excellence.
 About Suffolk Global: 
 Suffolk Global is a strategic extension of Suffolk Construction, established to unlock the full potential of a globally integrated delivery model. Based in Bangalore, India, Suffolk Global brings together world-class talent, advanced technology, and innovative processes to enhance how Suffolk designs, plans, and builds.
 By partnering closely with teams across the United States, Suffolk Global will help drive quality, scalability, and innovation while creating new opportunities for technical professionals to contribute to some of the most complex construction projects in North America.
 About Digital Delivery: 
 Suffolk is building the next generation of Digital Delivery capabilities to transform how buildings are designed, coordinated, and constructed. By combining Building Information Modeling (BIM), data-driven workflows, automation, and emerging technologies, our goal is to create a more connected, efficient, and predictable project delivery process.
 As part of this vision, Suffolk Global is establishing a high-performing Digital Delivery team in Bangalore that will partner directly with project teams across the United States. Together, we will develop scalable modeling standards, improve coordination workflows, enhance quality through digital reviews, and create innovative solutions that support some of the most complex construction projects in North America.
 This is an opportunity to help build a new capability from the ground up. Team members will play a critical role in defining best practices, developing digital standards, creating high-quality BIM content, and advancing model-based delivery across the enterprise.
 Digital Delivery Engineer II

 Location: Bangalore, India (Onsite)

 The Digital Delivery Engineer II is responsible for advanced BIM modeling, content development, constructability analysis, quality control, and coordination support across one or more projects.  The Digital Delivery Engineer II applies expert-level Revit skills to develop complex project models, create parametric content, perform detailed model reviews, and support multidisciplinary coordination workflows.  The Digital Delivery Engineer II must be able to interpret architectural and structural design drawings, specifications, and details, and develop coordinated LOD 300/350 models, shop drawings, and construction layouts.  Promote consistency and adherence to established modeling standards across projects.

 Support issue resolution workflows and validate corrective actions.
 Maintain accurate documentation of findings, recommendations, and project updates.

 Generate coordination reports, issue logs, and model review documentation.
 Assist project teams with tracking, communication, and resolution of coordination issues.
 Participate in coordination meetings and provide technical support for model-related discussions.
 Continuous Improvement:

 Support implementation of new technologies, tools, and digital delivery processes.

 Contribute to the ongoing development of Digital Delivery capabilities within Suffolk Global.

Neural Concept embeds AI into design and simulation workflows so engineering teams make continuous, data-driven decisions instead of waiting on sequential design–simulation–validation cycles. None of that matters until the platform is running inside the customer's environment, on their infrastructure, under their rules.
That is this role. You take an enterprise customer and make the platform real for them: architected, deployed, integrated, cleared by their security organisation, and stable enough that their engineers stop thinking about it. You own that outcome end to end for named accounts, as their primary technical counterpart.
   What you will do 
 The deployment, from the first architecture conversation through go-live and into steady-state operation.
 Its integration with the customer's identity, data and engineering systems, and the infrastructure and model serving layer beneath it.
 The relationship with their IT, security and platform teams: assessments, architecture reviews, and the call when something breaks.
 The diagnosis when it does break, including when the cause sits outside our own software.
 The runbooks, post-mortems and playbooks that make the next deployment easier, and the feedback loop into Product.
   Where you will do it 
Managed Kubernetes across the major clouds. On-premises and fully air-gapped clusters with no route to the internet, GPU infrastructure, self-hosted model serving. Customer HPC environments, schedulers, and shared storage under real load.
   If installing software with no internet access, on hardware you do not control, reads as the interesting part of the job rather than the obstacle, this will suit you.

 You will often be the only Neural Concept engineer in the room. We are looking for someone with:
 6+ years deploying and operating enterprise software in production, two of them in environments you did not control.
 Kubernetes at configuration depth: how chart values become rendered manifests, and why a workload will not start.
 Identity and SSO fundamentals: OIDC and SAML, clients and credential rotation, redirect URIs, group-to-role mapping.
 Linux, networking and TLS: DNS, routing, ingress and egress, certificate chains and interception proxies.
 Kubernetes storage: persistent volumes and CSI, access modes, diagnosing shared storage that degrades under load.
 Professional customer-facing English , and willingness to travel and work your customers' hours.
 Also valuable: regulated or air-gapped deployments · private registries and image mirroring · GPU scheduling and LLM serving · enterprise IdP administration · Terraform and GitOps · Prometheus and Grafana · HPC schedulers · ISO 27001 evidence · Python · PLM, CAD or CAE exposure.

 Work with a world-class technology team – our engineers are top-notch, and we always aim for excellence.
 Benefit from a competitive salary and rewarding opportunities as we continue to scale.
 Thrive in a collaborative, multicultural environment where your work is visible and recognized.
 Develop professionally alongside talented colleagues who share knowledge freely and support one another.
 Make a global impact by helping customers shift to AI-assisted design, making innovation faster, smarter, and more sustainable.
 Balance life and work with remote work or hybrid model (20% remote) —we care about results, not rigid schedules.
   Where You Will Be 
 Remote from Europe or one of our offices in Switzerland or Munich;
 Travelling: This position will require travelling to customer location within Europe

items.jobTitle: Research Engineer - Robotics RL & Post Training
items.jobDescription:
Accelerating embodied AGI. 
 The next ten years of AI will not be won in software. They will be won in the physical world: in factories, hospitals, kitchens, fields, and homes. The companies that own that data will own the century.
 microagi is building it. We are a data research and deployment lab. Atlas captures the manual work inside Europe’s industrial champions, trains foundation models on it, and deploys the right robot onto the floor, with no teleoperation and no interruption to the line. Shift records how physical work actually happens and turns it into training-ready data.
 We were founded by former Formula 1 engineers from Red Bull Racing and Mercedes, together with a researcher from the Alan Turing Institute. Our $55M seed round, the largest in German history, was led by Hummingbird with Northzone, LocalGlobe, Village Global, and redalpine. We are based in Munich, with our research centre in Zürich and teams in London, New York, and Istanbul. We are now building the engineering and research teams that will take Atlas into new industries.
 What you will work on 
 Train and refine RL policies for contact-rich manipulation, including precise assembly, insertion, and recovery from failures.
 Develop rewards, curricula, and reset strategies for efficient policy learning.
 Distill specialist capabilities into generalist policies through expert-generated data, imitation learning, and teacher–student methods.
 Investigate direct RL post-training of vision-language-action models and world-action models.
 Build data collection, filtering, sampling, and augmentation pipelines using demonstrations, autonomous rollouts, and human corrections.
 Build scientifically sound evaluation pipelines across simulation and real robots, measuring success, precision, speed, robustness, and recovery.
 Design controlled experiments and ablations that isolate the effects of algorithms, data, model changes, and training budgets.
 Diagnose and reduce sim-to-real gaps in dynamics, sensing, timing, and control.
 Build reliable, maintainable training and evaluation software with reproducible configurations, versioned data, and traceable results.
 What we are looking for 
 Strong practical experience implementing and debugging reinforcement learning for continuous control, ideally robotic manipulation.
 Experience with imitation learning and policy distillation or teacher–student training.
 Strong working knowledge of ML/DL fundamentals
 Strong software engineering skills: clear interfaces, maintainable code, meaningful tests, systematic debugging, and reliable experiment infrastructure.
 Strong Python and PyTorch or JAX skills, with the ability to own work from research implementation through real-robot evaluation.
 Experience designing rigorous evaluation protocols: meaningful baselines, held-out test conditions, leakage prevention, repeated trials, and appropriate uncertainty estimates.
 First-principles thinking: the ability to question assumptions, identify underlying mechanisms, and distinguish causal evidence from correlation.
 Experience with sim-to-real transfer and a robotics simulation stack such as MuJoCo or Isaac Sim / Isaac Lab.
 Evidence of substantial research contributions through publications at venues such as CoRL, RSS, ICRA, IROS, NeurIPS, ICML, or ICLR, or equivalent demonstrated research and engineering work.
 Especially relevant experience 
 RL post-training of pretrained VLAs or WAMs.
 Distilling multiple specialists into a shared generalist while preserving existing capabilities.
 Visual RL, privileged-information teachers, and contact-rich manipulation.
 Offline and online RL, human-in-the-loop learning, and learning from failures.
 Diffusion or flow-matching action policies and temporally chunked actions.
 Distributed training and large-scale rollout collection.
 What success looks like 
 Reproducible improvements in real-robot performance, supported by controlled experiments that explain what helped, where it generalizes, and where it still fails.
 Who Will Thrive at microagi
 Everyone we hire is assessed on the same four traits:
 Mission and vision: you care about what we are building and why it matters, and your past choices show it.
 Intensity: you work at a pace that matches the size of the opportunity, and you sustain it.
 Entrepreneurial: you start things nobody asked for, and you finish them.
 Raw IQ: you learn fast, reason from first principles, and get sharper when the problem changes.
 This is for you if: 
 You would rather own a problem end to end than wait for a spec.
 You use AI every day, and you can tell a correct answer from a plausible one.
 You want to work in person, in the office, with people who are very good at what they do.

Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented. 
The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.
We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.
We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.
 The Role 
 You will own products from the first conversation about a problem to the moment customers use them, and keep improving them after launch. That means figuring out what matters, cutting the scope to something useful, designing the experience and API, building across the stack, and taking responsibility for how it works in production.
 You will own clearing products for Global Banks and Financial Institutions such as big Banks in Mexiko, fintechs in Nigeria or Central Banks in Southeast Asia. This could be anything across accounts, payments, treasury, credit, FX, multi-currency, our public APIs or the dashboard. You will own products and features end to end, meaning from working with a customer to shipping something to have impact.
 We expect you to combine incredible bias to AI with great technical taste and hard work. Own problems, build products, ship value. At all times, you are responsible for the code you write, so you must be able to write, understand and debug code. Fast implementation only matters when the product solves the right problem and works reliably.
 This is a demanding role with substantial ownership. You will learn unfamiliar domains quickly, make decisions with incomplete information and put sustained effort into getting difficult things over the line. You will have a lot of say about how you design features and how our product looks like.
 Your First Six Months 
 Weeks 1-2: Ship one big feature to a customer with taste. 
 Months 1-3: Launch one new product to customers. 
 Months 4-6: Own and iteratively improve one product. 
 Months 7-12: Own and launch new products. Build an enablement system for agents around launching the products you own.
   Who Will Thrive At Augustus 
 We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:
 American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.
 Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.
 Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.
 Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.
 This role is for you if: 
 You see an awkward workflow and start figuring out how to make it better. You can show us something you took from an idea to a working product, and explain the decisions you made.
 You learn unfamiliar systems quickly. You ask precise questions, find the underlying constraints and change your mind when the evidence changes.
 You care a LOT about product experience: API naming, sensible defaults, loading states, clear errors and what happens when something fails.
 You use agents to attempt more ambitious work. You can show how you steer them, catch their mistakes and verify the result.
 You move quickly and work hard. When a project gets difficult, you narrow the problem, seek help where needed and keep ownership until it works.
 You can choose the smallest useful solution and still insist on correctness, security and a good user experience.
 You want responsibility that grows with your ability. Your strongest evidence might come from a startup, a job, open-source work or something you built independently.
 This is not for you if: 
 You need others to get your stuff done.
 You do not enjoy talking to customers.
 You vibe code stuff without adding quality gates and correctness checks.
 You treat product decisions as someone else's responsibility.
 You are not able to pick up new complex domains quickly.
 You do not enjoy working long hours.
 Hard Requirements 
 Must Haves: 
 At least one working product or substantial feature you personally built and can discuss in depth. Commercial, independent and open-source work all count; confidential work can be discussed without sharing private code.
 Hands-on use of coding agents, including the ability to review their output and identify incorrect or unsafe behavior.
 Based in Berlin or open to relocate.
 Strong preference: 
 Experience shipping a product with real users and improving it from feedback.
 Evidence of unusually strong independent work: a useful side project, meaningful open-source contributions, a company you built or substantial ownership in a small team.
 Experience with APIs, payments or financial products. Banking experience is useful, but not required.
 There is no minimum number of years of experience or degree requirement. We assess demonstrated ability and scope of ownership.
 Pay transparency 
 Compensation packages at Augustus include base salary, equity, and benefits. New hire offers are made based on a candidate's experience, expertise and geographic location. The annual base salary range for this role is €70,000-€100,000 + equity and benefits.
 What We Offer 
 Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.
 Network: Your peers are brilliant, highly motivated people. These people will be foundational in your future opportunities.
 Real Participation: Employees are shareholders. You will think and act like an owner.
 Perks & Benefits: Relocation support, visa support, the latest Apple gear (MacBook + AirPods), lunch benefit, gym benefit, a beautiful office in the heart of the city, 4x on-/offsites per year, and an annual development budget.
 Additional to the global benefits above, we offer localized benefits such as comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance and a 401(k) retirement plan for our US team.
 Augustus is committed to creating an inclusive environment where people from all backgrounds can thrive and where different viewpoints and experiences are valued and respected. Augustus will consider all applications for employment without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, religious beliefs, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, neurodiversity, disability, age, parental or veteran status.

Technologien für morgen gestalten: Das ist unsere Mission am Fraunhofer-Institut für Optronik, Systemtechnik und Bildauswertung IOSB. Wir betreiben grundlegende und anwendungsnahe Forschung in den Themenfeldern Lasertechnologie, Photonik, bildgebende Sensorsysteme und vieles mehr. Unsere Expertise reicht von den physikalischen Grundlagen der Optik und Photonik bis zur Datenauswertung mittels KI für verschiedenste Anwendungsdomänen. Wo Forschung auf Praxis trifft, beginnt Veränderung – und genau hier gestalten wir gemeinsam die Zukunft.
 Unsere Abteilung Lasertechnologie (LAS), befasst sich mit der Forschung und Entwicklung spezifischer photonischer Materialien und Komponenten, zugehörigen Laserquellen und nichtlinearen Konvertern sowie der Optimierung von Lasersystemen im NIR, SWIR, MWIR und LWIR Bereich für unterschiedliche Anwendungsfelder.
 Klingt interessant? Dann bewerben Sie sich jetzt und unterstützen Sie unsere Kolleg*innen der Abteilung LAS dabei, den State of the Art in Sachen Hochleistungs-Festkörperlaser mit vorantreiben. Dabei sollte es Sie nicht scheuen, auch in Projekten mitzuarbeiten, die der Bundeswehr zugutekommen.
 Hier sorgen Sie für Veränderung 
 Sie entwickeln, untersuchen und optimieren eigenverantwortlich Laserdesigns und Laseraufbauten unter Verwendung von photonischen Komponenten mit neuen Funktionalitäten
 Sie beschäftigen sich mit der wissenschaftlichen Untersuchung von Festkörperlasern zur Bewertung verschiedener Laserarchitekturen in einem breit aufgestellten Team von Experten im Gebiet der photonischen Komponenten, Laserquellen und nichtlinearen Konverter
 Sie bearbeiten Projekte in der Festkörperlasertechnik eigenständig und verfassen Berichte und Publikationen in deutscher und englischer Sprache
 Hiermit bringen Sie sich ein 
 Ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Diplom/Master) der Physik, Elektrotechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung
 Wünschenswert ist zudem eine abgeschlossene Promotion in dem Bereich bzw. das Interesse an einer Promotion
 Berufserfahrung in Design und Realisierung von Festkörperlasern (Design von Laserresonatoren, Aufbau optischer Komponenten, thermische Effekte in Festkörperlasern) und zugehöriger Messtechnik (Strahlqualität, Spektrum, zeitliche Dynamik etc.)
 Idealerweise Kenntnisse sowie Berufserfahrung in einem oder mehreren der Bereiche Faseroptik, Mikrooptik, Kristalloptik, elektrooptische und akustooptische Komponenten sowie Festkörperphysik 
 Was wir für Sie bereithalten 
 Eine abwechslungsreiche, spannende Tätigkeit an der Schnittstelle zwischen Wissenschaft und Wirtschaft, zwischen Gegenwart und Zukunft
 Großen Freiraum zur Entfaltung und zum selbstbestimmten Vorantreiben von Themen und Projekten in einer expandierenden Abteilung

items.jobDescription:
Die »Digitale Transformation« und die »Industrie 4.0« verändern Entwicklungs- und Produktionsbereiche immer stärker. Menschen, Produkte, IT-Systeme, Maschinen, Anlagen und vieles mehr werden vernetzt und kommunizieren verstärkt mittels mobiler Endgeräte.
Viele Unternehmen fragen sich, wie sie die Digitalisierung für sich am besten nutzbar machen und welche Potenziale sie wie heben können. Die Leistungen des Forschungsbereichs » Cognitive Engineering and Production « am Fraunhofer-Institut für Arbeitswirtschaft und Organisation IAO helfen ihnen, Strategien, Prozesse, die Organisation und den Einsatz von Technologien in ihrem produzierenden Unternehmen modern, effizient und systematisch zu gestalten. Dafür haben wir nicht nur jahrelange Erfahrung aus praktischen Beratungsprojekten, sondern bringen auch immer wieder die neuesten wissenschaftlichen Erkenntnisse aus der Forschung in die Anwendung.
 Mittels innovativer Methoden und langjähriger Erfahrung in der Produkt- und Produktionsentwicklung betrachten unsere Expertenteams den Produktentstehungsprozess von der Idee über die Entwicklung bis hin zur Produktion. Für wettbewerbsstärkende Lösungen erproben wir neue Produkte und Prozesse in virtuellen Labs, wie dem »Immersive Engineering Lab«. Diese Prozesse entwickeln wir dann in realitätsnahen Umgebungen wie dem »Future Work Lab« weiter und bringen so Neues schnell in die Anwendung.
 Unsere Forschungs­schwerpunkte:
 Prozessoptimierung im produzierenden Unternehmen: Vom digital unterstützen Engineering bis zur schlanken Gestaltung des Auftragsdurchlaufes in der Produktion
 Passender IT-Einsatz für die Produktentwicklung
 Use Cases und maßgeschneiderte Industrie 4.0-Lösungen für die Produktion von der Idee bis zur Einführung
 Turbulenzfeste Auslegung eines attraktiven Personaleinsatzes in der Produktion, Dimensionierung der erforderlichen flexiblen Beschäftigungsformen und Konzeption von ergonomischen Schichtmodellen
 Bewertung und Gestaltung von Arbeitsplätzen in der Produktion mit »Exoskeletten«
 Digitalisierung der Produktion und digitaler Schatten – von der ersten Beratung bis zur konkreten Entwicklung und Optimierung intelligenter Produkte, Prozesse oder ganzer Fabriken
 Entwicklung von Technologien und Anwendungen für die virtuelle Realität mit Schwerpunkten im Engineering in der verarbeitenden Industrie
 Neue Technologien und Konzepte für die Mensch-Technik-Interaktion in der vernetzten Produktion
 Interactive Surfaces & Spaces
 Einsatz von VR/AR zum Lernen und für Remoteszenarien
 Was Sie bei uns tun 
 Zu Ihrem Tätigkeitsfeld gehört die Mitarbeit an Forschungs- und Beratungsprojekten einer unserer Teams:
 Digital Manufacturing
 Vernetzte Produktionssysteme
 Produktionsmanagement
 Digital Engineering
 Advanced Systems Engineering
 Visual Interactive Technologies
 Bitte geben Sie bei Ihrer Bewerbung an, für welches der oben aufgeführten Teams Sie sich besonders interessieren. 
 Was Sie mitbringen 
 Wir suchen passionierte, kreative und unternehmerisch denkende Persönlichkeiten, die Spaß daran haben, mit eigenen Ideen die Ziele unserer Teams proaktiv voranzutreiben.
 Freundliches und kommunikatives Auftreten, auch vor Führungskräften und Management, einen engagierten und konsequenten Arbeitsstil, Eigeninitiative und Kundenorientierung
 Eine sehr gute, auch schriftliche, Ausdrucksweise in der deutschen Sprache rundet Ihr Profil ab
 Von Vorteil ist ein abgeschlossenes Studium in den Bereichen: Technologiemanagement, Digital Management, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, Maschinenbau, Produktionsmanagement, Produktentwicklung, AR/VR

 Bei uns erwarten Sie anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben mit Verantwortung und Gestaltungsspielraum in einem innovativen Forschungsumfeld. Ein teamorientiertes Arbeiten und ein hervorragendes Arbeitsklima sind uns sehr wichtig. Des Weiteren bieten wir Ihnen:

 Work-Life-Blending-Angebote wie flexibles Arbeitsmodell (Gleitzeit), Optionen für mobiles Arbeiten und Unterstützungsangebote zur Vereinbarkeit von Familie und Beruf (u. a. Notfallbetreuung über unseren Familienservice, Home- und Eldercare, mobiles Mit-Kind-Büro)

 This is a permanent position (CDI) based in Bordeaux,  with 4 days on-site per week. 
 1. The Team You'll Join
 You'll be part of our Data Experience squad led by Alexandre Blanchard , Data Engineering Manager within Mirakl's broader Data team of 70 specialists. Together, you'll be building and scaling the ML infrastructure that powers Mirakl's AI-driven products from real-time recommendation inference to LLM fine-tuning pipelines serving some of the world's most innovative e-commerce players. 
 2. Your Impact
 Design and implement a performant, robust, and scalable ML Platform architecture — covering training, evaluation, and inference — while keeping costs under control

 Partner with Data Scientists from project kickoff through productionization — setting up best practices, guardrails, and CI/CD improvements in collaboration with the SRE team
 Drive technical excellence: manage technical debt, systematize version upgrade processes, and upskill team members on MLOps and Data Engineering topics
 Contribute to cutting-edge AI projects — including LoRA adapter creation for open-source LLM fine-tuning, in-house computer vision models, and large-scale product data transformation — and share findings across Labs teams
 3. What You'll Bring to the Role
 Experience: 
 2+ years of experience in a Machine Learning and/or Data engineering environment
 Proven track record of shipping ML applications at scale (NLP, image processing, or classical ML) in high-volume, production-grade systems
 Background in software development with a strong appetite for data science and machine learning
 Skills: 
 Proficiency in Python and the Kubernetes/Docker ecosystem
 Solid experience with cloud environments (AWS primarily) and Apache ecosystem frameworks
 Hands-on knowledge of an orchestration tool (Airflow, Prefect, or equivalent)
 Familiarity with CI/CD practices and MLOps principles (monitoring, model lifecycle, reproducibility)
 Strong communicator with a knack for mentoring and presenting technical work to diverse audiences

 Experience with: Python, Databricks, AWS, Kafka, Airflow, Prefect, MLflow, TensorFlow, Triton, PyTorch, vLLM, KServe, Delta Lake, Kubernetes, SQL, Terraform, Apache Spark
